verses.1:1: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, and has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat on the seat of the pestilent;
verses.1:2: rather, his desire is in the law of the Lord, and in His law he will meditate day and night.
verses.1:3: And he will be like the tree planted beside the channels of the waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and its leaf will not fall off; and everything that he does will be prospered.
verses.1:4: Not so are the ungodly, not so; rather, they are like the dust that the wind hurls away from the face of the earth.
verses.1:5: Therefore the ungodly will not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the council of the righteous;
verses.1:6: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly will perish.
verses.2:1: Why did nations rage, and peoples meditate on empty things?
verses.2:2: The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against His anointed. Interlude.
verses.2:3: "Let us tear apart their bonds and cast away their yoke from us."
verses.2:4: He who dwells in the heavens will laugh at them, and the Lord will mock them.
verses.2:5: Then He will speak to them in His anger, and in His fury He will dismay them.
verses.2:6: But I was established by Him upon Zion, His holy mountain,
verses.2:7: proclaiming the decree of the Lord. The Lord said to Me, "You are My Son; I have fathered You today.
verses.2:8: Ask from Me, and I will give You nations as Your inheritance, and as Your possession the ends of the earth;
verses.2:9: You will shepherd them with an iron rod; like a potter's vessel You will shatter them."
verses.2:10: And now, kings, understand; be instructed, all you who judge the earth.
verses.2:11: Serve the Lord with fear, and exult in Him with trembling.
verses.2:12: Take hold of instruction, or else the Lord may become angry, and you will perish from the righteous way, when His fury is quickly kindled. Blessed are all who trust in Him.
verses.3:1: A psalm for David, when he was fleeing from the presence of Absalom his son.
verses.3:2: Lord, why have those who afflict me multiplied? Many are rising up against me;
verses.3:3: many are saying to my soul, "There is no salvation in his God." Interlude.
verses.3:4: But You, Lord, are my sustainer, my glory, and the One who lifts up my head.
verses.3:5: With my voice I cried out to the Lord, and He heard me from His holy mountain. Interlude.
verses.3:6: I lay down and slept. I awoke, for the Lord will sustain me.
verses.3:7: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who are attacking me all around.
verses.3:8: Arise, Lord; save me, my God; for You have struck all who are hostile to me without cause; You have shattered the teeth of sinners.
verses.3:9: Salvation belongs to the Lord, and Your blessing is upon Your people.
verses.4:1: For the end, with psalms; a song for David.
verses.4:2: When I called out, the God of my righteousness heard me; in distress You made room for me. Have compassion on me and hear my prayer.
verses.4:3: Sons of men, how long will you be heavy-hearted? Why do you love emptiness and seek falsehood? Interlude.
verses.4:4: And know that the Lord has made His devout one wondrous; the Lord will hear me when I cry out to Him.
verses.4:5: Be angry, and do not sin; for the things you say in your heart, be pierced with remorse on your beds. Interlude.
verses.4:6: Offer a sacrifice of righteousness, and hope in the Lord.
verses.4:7: Many say, "Who will show us good things?" The light of Your face has been marked upon us, Lord.
verses.4:8: You have put gladness into my heart; from the fruit of their grain and wine and oil they were multiplied.
verses.4:9: In peace I will at once lie down and sleep, because You, Lord, alone have settled me in hope.
verses.5:1: For the end, concerning her who inherits; a psalm for David.
verses.5:2: Give ear to my words, Lord; understand my cry.
verses.5:3: Pay attention to the voice of my supplication, my King and my God, because to You I will pray, Lord.
verses.5:4: In the morning You will hear my voice; in the morning I will stand before You and watch.
verses.5:5: For You are not a God who desires lawlessness, nor will one who does evil sojourn with You.
verses.5:6: Lawbreakers will not remain before Your eyes; You have hated, Lord, all who practice lawlessness.
verses.5:7: You will destroy all who speak falsehood; the Lord detests a man of bloodshed and a deceitful man.
verses.5:8: But I, in the abundance of Your mercy, will enter into Your house; I will worship toward Your holy temple in fear of You.
verses.5:9: Lord, guide me in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make my way straight before You.
verses.5:10: For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is empty. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they practiced deceit.
verses.5:11: Judge them, God; let them fall away from their counsels. According to the multitude of their acts of ungodliness, drive them out, because they embittered You, Lord.
verses.5:12: And let all who hope in You be glad in You; they will exult forever, and You will dwell among them. And all who love Your name will boast in You,
verses.5:13: because You bless a righteous person. Lord, as with a shield of favor You have crowned us.
verses.6:1: For the end, with hymns, concerning the eighth; a psalm for David.
verses.6:2: Lord, in Your wrath do not rebuke me, nor in Your anger discipline me.
verses.6:3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; heal me, for my bones have been troubled.
verses.6:4: And my soul has been greatly troubled; and You, Lord, how long?
verses.6:5: Turn back, Lord, rescue my soul; save me for the sake of Your mercy.
verses.6:6: For in death there is no one who remembers You; and in Hades, who will give thanks to You?
verses.6:7: I have grown weary in my groaning; every night I will wash my bed; with my tears I will drench my bedding.
verses.6:8: My eye has been troubled because of wrath; I have grown old among all my enemies.
verses.6:9: Depart from me, all you who practice lawlessness, because the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.6:10: The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord has accepted my prayer.
verses.6:11: May all my enemies be put to shame and greatly troubled; may they be turned back and be greatly put to shame swiftly.
verses.7:1: A psalm for David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Chusi son of Jemini.
verses.7:2: Lord, my God, in You I have hoped; save me from all who pursue me and rescue me,
verses.7:3: so that he may never seize my soul like a lion, while there is no one who redeems or saves.
verses.7:4: Lord, my God, if I have done this, if there is injustice in my hands,
verses.7:5: if I have repaid those who repay me with evil, then may I fall away from my enemies empty;
verses.7:6: then may the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, and trample my life into the ground, and make my glory dwell in the dust. Interlude.
verses.7:7: Arise, Lord, in Your wrath; be exalted in the boundaries of my enemies; awaken, Lord, my God, in the decree that You have commanded.
verses.7:8: And an assembly of peoples will surround You; and above it return on high.
verses.7:9: The Lord will judge peoples; judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to my innocence upon me.
verses.7:10: Now let the wickedness of sinners come to an end, and You will direct a righteous person; God examines hearts and kidneys.
verses.7:11: Righteous is my help from God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.7:12: God is a righteous judge, strong and patient, not bringing wrath each day.
verses.7:13: If you do not turn back, He will polish His sword; He has bent His bow and prepared it;
verses.7:14: and in it He has prepared instruments of death; He has fashioned His arrows for those who burn.
verses.7:15: Look, he was in labor with lawlessness; he conceived trouble and gave birth to injustice;
verses.7:16: he dug a pit and dug it out, and he will fall into the hole that he made;
verses.7:17: his trouble will return upon his head, and his injustice will come down upon the crown of his head.
verses.7:18: I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.8:1: For the end, concerning the winepresses; a psalm for David.
verses.8:2: Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is Your name in all the earth; for Your magnificence has been lifted up above the heavens.
verses.8:3: Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies You have prepared praise on account of Your enemies, to destroy an enemy and an avenger.
verses.8:4: For I will see the heavens, the works of Your fingers, the moon and stars that You founded.
verses.8:5: What is man, that You remember him, or a son of man, that You attend to him?
verses.8:6: You made him a little lower than angels; with glory and honor You crowned him.
verses.8:7: And You appointed him over the works of Your hands; You subjected all things beneath his feet,
verses.8:8: sheep and all cattle, and also the beasts of the field,
verses.8:9: the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea, the things that pass through the paths of the seas.
verses.8:10: Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is Your name in all the earth.
verses.9:1: For the end, concerning the hidden things of the son; a psalm for David.
verses.9:2: I will give thanks to You, Lord, with my whole heart; I will recount all Your wonders;
verses.9:3: I will be glad and exult in You; I will sing praise to Your name, Most High.
verses.9:4: When my enemy is turned back, they will grow weak and perish from Your presence.
verses.9:5: For You have executed my judgment and my cause; You sat on a throne, You who judge righteousness.
verses.9:6: You rebuked nations, and the ungodly one perished; You blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.9:7: The swords of the enemy have failed completely, and You tore down cities; their memory perished with a sound;
verses.9:8: And the Lord remains forever; He has prepared His throne in judgment.
verses.9:9: And He Himself will judge the inhabited world in righteousness; He will judge peoples in uprightness.
verses.9:10: And the Lord became a refuge for the needy, a helper at opportune times, in distress.
verses.9:11: And let those who know Your name hope in You, because You have not forsaken those who seek You out, Lord.
verses.9:12: Sing praise to the Lord who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations;
verses.9:13: for He who seeks out their blood has remembered; He has not forgotten the plea of the needy.
verses.9:14: Have mercy on me, Lord; see my humiliation from my enemies, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.9:15: so that I may declare all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will exult in Your salvation.
verses.9:16: Nations have been stuck fast in the destruction that they made; in this snare that they hid, their foot was caught.
verses.9:17: The Lord is known as executing judgments; in the works of his hands the sinner was caught. Song of an interlude.
verses.9:18: Let the sinners be turned back into Hades, all the nations that forget God.
verses.9:19: For the poor person will not be forgotten to the end; the endurance of the needy will not perish forever.
verses.9:20: Arise, Lord; let man not grow strong; let nations be judged before You.
verses.9:21: Appoint, Lord, a lawgiver over them; let nations know that they are men. Interlude.
verses.9:22: Why, Lord, have You stood far off? Do You take no notice at opportune times, in distress?
verses.9:23: While the ungodly one acts arrogantly, the poor person is set on fire; they are caught in the schemes that they devise.
verses.9:24: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul, and the one who does injustice is blessed.
verses.9:25: The sinner has provoked the Lord; according to the abundance of his wrath he will not inquire; God is not before him.
verses.9:26: His ways are profaned at every time; Your judgments are taken away from his presence; he will have dominion over all his enemies.
verses.9:27: For he said in his heart, "I will never be shaken, from generation to generation without evil."
verses.9:28: His mouth is full of cursing and bitterness and deceit; under his tongue are toil and trouble.
verses.9:29: He sits in ambush with the rich in hidden places to kill an innocent person; his eyes look intently at the needy.
verses.9:30: He lies in ambush in a hidden place, like a lion in his den; he lies in ambush to seize a poor person, to seize a poor person as he drags him; in his snare
verses.9:31: he will humble him; he will stoop and fall when he has dominion over the needy.
verses.9:32: For he said in his heart, "God has forgotten; He has turned away His face so as never to see."
verses.9:33: Arise, Lord God; let Your hand be lifted up; do not forget the needy.
verses.9:34: For what reason has the ungodly one provoked God? For he said in his heart, "He will not inquire."
verses.9:35: You see, for You will observe trouble and fury, to deliver them into Your hands. To You, therefore, the poor person has been left; to an orphan You were a helper.
verses.9:36: Crush the arm of the sinner and wicked one; his sin will be sought out, and he will by no means be found on account of it.
verses.9:37: The Lord will reign forever and ever; you will perish, nations, from His land.
verses.9:38: The Lord has heard the desire of the needy; Your ear has paid attention to the readiness of their heart,
verses.9:39: to render justice for the orphan and the humble, so that man may no longer boast arrogantly upon the earth.
verses.10:1: For the end. A psalm for David. In the Lord I have put my trust; how will you say to my soul, "Flee away to the mountains like a sparrow"?
verses.10:2: For look, the sinners have bent a bow; they have prepared arrows in a quiver to shoot down the upright in heart in moonless darkness.
verses.10:3: For what You established, they have torn down; and what has the righteous one done?
verses.10:4: The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord—in heaven is His throne. His eyes look toward the needy; His eyelids examine the sons of men.
verses.10:5: The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly, but the one who loves unrighteousness hates his own soul.
verses.10:6: He will rain snares upon sinners; fire and sulfur and a storm wind will be the portion of their cup.
verses.10:7: For the Lord is righteous and has loved righteous deeds; His face has seen uprightness.
verses.11:1: For the end, concerning the eighth. A psalm for David.
verses.11:2: Save me, Lord, for the devout one has vanished, for truths have diminished from among the sons of men.
verses.11:3: Each one has spoken empty things to his neighbor; deceitful lips have spoken with a heart and a heart.
verses.11:4: May the Lord utterly destroy all the deceitful lips and a boastful tongue,
verses.11:5: those who have said, "We will magnify our tongue, our lips belong to us; who is lord over us?"
verses.11:6: "Because of the misery of the poor and because of the groaning of the needy, now I will rise up," says the Lord. "I will set them in salvation; I will speak boldly in it."
verses.11:7: The utterances of the Lord are pure utterances, silver refined by fire, tested in the earth, purified sevenfold.
verses.11:8: You, Lord, will guard us and will preserve us from this generation and forever.
verses.11:9: The ungodly walk all around; according to Your height You have greatly esteemed the sons of men.
verses.12:1: For the end. A psalm for David. How long, Lord, will You forget me to the end? How long will You turn Your face away from me?
verses.12:2: How long will I place counsels in my soul, sorrows in my heart by day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.12:3: Look, hear me, Lord my God; give light to my eyes, so that I do not fall asleep in death,
verses.12:4: so that my enemy may not say, "I have prevailed against him"; those who afflict me will rejoice if I am shaken.
verses.12:5: But I have hoped in Your mercy; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.12:6: I will sing to the Lord, who has done good to me, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord, the Most High.
verses.13:1: For the end; a psalm for David. A fool said in his heart, "There is no God." They acted corruptly and became abominable in practices; there is no one doing goodness, there is not even one.
verses.13:2: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks out God.
verses.13:3: All turned aside, together they became worthless; there is no one doing goodness, there is not even one. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they practiced deceit. Venom of asps is beneath their lips, whose mouth is filled with cursing and bitterness. Their feet are quick to shed blood; ruin and wretchedness are in their ways, and they did not know the way of peace. There is no fear of God in front of their eyes.
verses.13:4: Will all who work unrighteousness not know, those who devour My people like eating bread? They did not call upon the Lord.
verses.13:5: There they cowered in fear where there was no fear, because God is in a righteous generation.
verses.13:6: You put to shame the counsel of a poor man, because the Lord is his hope.
verses.13:7: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back the captivity of His people, let Jacob exult and let Israel be glad.
verses.14:1: A psalm for David. Lord, who will sojourn in Your tent? And who will dwell on Your holy mountain?
verses.14:2: One who walks without blemish and works righteousness, speaking truth in his heart;
verses.14:3: who has not deceived with his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbor, and has not taken up a reproach against those nearest to him.
verses.14:4: One who acts wickedly is despised before him, but he honors those who fear the Lord. He swears to his neighbor and does not break faith.
verses.14:5: He has not given his money at interest, and he has not taken bribes against the innocent. The one who does these things will never be shaken.
verses.15:1: A pillar inscription for David. Guard me, Lord, for I have hoped in You.
verses.15:2: I said to the Lord, "You are my Lord."
verses.15:3: For the holy ones who are in His land, He made all His desires wonderful in them.
verses.15:4: Their weaknesses were multiplied; after these things they hurried. I will by no means assemble their assemblies of blood, nor will I ever make mention of their names through my lips.
verses.15:5: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup; You are the One who restores my inheritance to me.
verses.15:6: Measuring lines have fallen to me in the finest places; for indeed, my inheritance is the finest to me.
verses.15:7: I will bless the Lord who gave me understanding; furthermore, even until night my kidneys instructed me.
verses.15:8: I kept seeing the Lord before me at all times, because He is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.
verses.15:9: For this reason my heart became glad and my tongue exulted; furthermore, my flesh also will dwell in hope.
verses.15:10: For You will not leave my soul behind in Hades, nor will You permit Your devout one to see corruption.
verses.15:11: You made known to me ways of life; You will fill me with gladness in Your presence; delights are in Your right hand forever.
verses.16:1: A prayer of David. Hear, Lord, my righteousness; pay attention to my supplication; give ear to my prayer, not with deceitful lips.
verses.16:2: May my judgment come forth from Your presence; let my eyes see uprightness.
verses.16:3: You tested my heart; You visited by night; You refined me by fire, and no unrighteousness was found in me.
verses.16:4: So that my mouth might not speak the works of people, because of the words of Your lips I kept hard ways.
verses.16:5: Make firm my steps in Your paths, so that my steps may not be shaken.
verses.16:6: I cried out, because You listened to me, God; incline Your ear to me and hear my words.
verses.16:7: Make Your mercies wondrous, You who save those who hope in You from those who resist Your right hand.
verses.16:8: Guard me as the pupil of an eye. In the shelter of Your wings You will shelter me
verses.16:9: from the face of the ungodly who afflicted me. My enemies surrounded my soul;
verses.16:10: they closed up their fat; their mouth spoke arrogance.
verses.16:11: Casting me out, they have now encircled me; they set their eyes to incline to the ground.
verses.16:12: They laid hold of me like a lion ready for prey, and like a young lion dwelling in hidden places.
verses.16:13: Arise, Lord, confront them and trip them up; deliver my soul from an ungodly one, Your sword
verses.16:14: from enemies of Your hand. Lord, dismissing from the earth, divide them in their life; and their belly was filled with Your hidden things; they were satisfied with pork, and they left the remnants to their infants.
verses.16:15: But as for me, in righteousness I will appear before Your face; I will be satisfied when Your glory appears.
verses.17:1: For the end; for the servant of the Lord, David, what he spoke to the Lord, the words of this song, on the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul,
verses.17:2: and he said, "I will love You, Lord, my strength.
verses.17:3: The Lord is my stronghold and my refuge and my deliverer; my God is a helper, and I will hope in Him; my protector and a horn of salvation, my upholder.
verses.17:4: Praising, I will call upon the Lord, and I will be saved from my enemies.
verses.17:5: Pangs of death surrounded me, and torrents of lawlessness terrified me;
verses.17:6: pangs of Hades encircled me; snares of death confronted me.
verses.17:7: And in my distress I called upon the Lord, and to my God I cried out; He heard my voice from His holy temple, and my cry before Him will enter into His ears.
verses.17:8: And the earth was shaken and trembled, and the foundations of the mountains were troubled and shaken, because God was angry with them.
verses.17:9: Smoke went up in His wrath, and fire blazed fiercely before Him; coals were kindled from Him.
verses.17:10: And He bent heaven and came down, and thick darkness was under His feet.
verses.17:11: And He mounted upon cherubim and flew; He flew upon wings of winds.
verses.17:12: And He made darkness His hiding place; around Him was His tent, dark water in clouds of the skies.
verses.17:13: From the brightness before Him the clouds passed through, hail and coals of fire.
verses.17:14: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave His voice.
verses.17:15: And He sent out arrows and scattered them, and He multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into confusion.
verses.17:16: And the springs of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered at Your rebuke, Lord, at the blast of the breath of Your wrath.
verses.17:17: He sent out from on high and took me; He took hold of me from many waters.
verses.17:18: He will deliver me from my strong enemies and from those who hate me, because they grew stronger than I.
verses.17:19: They confronted me on the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my support,
verses.17:20: and He brought me out into a broad place; He will deliver me, because He desired me.
verses.17:21: He will deliver me from my strong enemies and from those who hate me. And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to the cleanness of my hands He will repay me.
verses.17:22: For I kept the ways of the Lord, and I did not act ungodly away from my God;
verses.17:23: for all His judgments were before me, and His ordinances did not depart from me.
verses.17:24: And I will be blameless with Him, and I will guard myself from my lawlessness.
verses.17:25: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the cleanness of my hands before His eyes.
verses.17:26: With a devout one You will show Yourself devout, and with an innocent man You will be innocent,
verses.17:27: and with a chosen one You will be chosen, and with a crooked one You will act crookedly.
verses.17:28: For You will save a humble people, and You will humble the eyes of the arrogant;
verses.17:29: for You will light my lamp, Lord; my God, You will light up my darkness.
verses.17:30: For by You I will be delivered from a raiding band, and by my God I will scale a wall.
verses.17:31: My God, His way is blameless; the utterances of the Lord are refined by fire; He is a protector of all who hope in Him.
verses.17:32: For who is God besides the Lord? And who is God besides our God?
verses.17:33: The God who girds me with strength, and made my way blameless;
verses.17:34: who makes my feet firm like a deer's, and sets me upon the high places;
verses.17:35: teaching my hands for war, and You made my arms a bronze bow.
verses.17:36: And You gave me the protection of my salvation, and Your right hand upheld me; and Your discipline set me upright to the end, and Your discipline itself will teach me.
verses.17:37: You broadened my steps beneath me, and my footsteps did not grow weak.
verses.17:38: I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they fail;
verses.17:39: I will crush them, and they will by no means be able to stand; they will fall under my feet.
verses.17:40: And You girded me with strength for war; You bound the feet of all those who rise up against me beneath me.
verses.17:41: And You gave me the back of my enemies, and You utterly destroyed those who hate me.
verses.17:42: They cried out, and there was no one to save; to the Lord, and He did not hear them.
verses.17:43: And I will grind them fine like dust before the face of the wind; like mud of the streets I will flatten them.
verses.17:44: Deliver me from the disputes of a people; You will appoint me as head of nations; a people whom I did not know served me;
verses.17:45: at the hearing of the ear they obeyed me; foreign sons lied to me;
verses.17:46: foreign sons grew old and limped away from their paths.
verses.17:47: The Lord lives, and blessed be my God, and let the God of my salvation be exalted,
verses.17:48: the God who gives acts of vengeance to me and subdued peoples under me,
verses.17:49: my deliverer from wrathful enemies; from those who rise up against me You will exalt me; from an unrighteous man You will deliver me.
verses.17:50: Therefore I will give thanks to You among the nations, Lord, and I will sing praises to Your name,
verses.17:51: magnifying the acts of salvation of His king, and showing mercy to His anointed, to David and to his seed forever."
verses.18:1: For the end; a psalm for David.
verses.18:2: The heavens recount the glory of God, and the expanse announces the work of His hands.
verses.18:3: Day pours forth an utterance to day, and night announces knowledge to night.
verses.18:4: There are neither speeches nor words whose voices are not heard.
verses.18:5: Into all the earth their sound has gone out, and to the ends of the inhabited world their utterances.
verses.18:6: In the sun He set His tent; and it, like a bridegroom coming out from his bridal chamber, will exult like a giant to run its course.
verses.18:7: From the end of heaven is its going out, and its destination is to the end of heaven; and there is no one who will be hidden from its heat.
verses.18:8: The law of the Lord is blameless, restoring souls; the testimony of the Lord is faithful, making infants wise.
verses.18:9: The ordinances of the Lord are upright, gladdening the heart; the commandment of the Lord is radiant, illuminating the eyes.
verses.18:10: The fear of the Lord is pure, remaining forever and ever; the judgments of the Lord are true, justified altogether,
verses.18:11: more desirable than gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and honeycomb.
verses.18:12: For indeed Your servant keeps them; in keeping them there is much reward.
verses.18:13: Who will understand transgressions? Cleanse me from my hidden things,
verses.18:14: and spare Your servant from strangers; if they do not rule over me, then I will be blameless and I will be cleansed from great sin.
verses.18:15: And the sayings of my mouth and the meditation of my heart will be well-pleasing before You continually, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
verses.19:1: For the end; a psalm for David.
verses.19:2: May the Lord hear you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob shield you.
verses.19:3: May He send out help to you from the holy place, and from Zion may He support you.
verses.19:4: May He remember every sacrifice of yours, and may He make your whole burnt offering fat. Interlude.
verses.19:5: May He give to you according to your heart, and may He fulfill your whole plan.
verses.19:6: Let us exult in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will be magnified. May the Lord fulfill all your requests.
verses.19:7: Now I know that the Lord has saved His anointed; He will hear him from His holy heaven; in mighty deeds is the salvation of His right hand.
verses.19:8: Some in chariots and some in horses, but we will be magnified in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.19:9: They were fettered and fell, but we rose up and were set upright.
verses.19:10: Lord, save Your king, and hear us on whatever day we call upon You.
verses.20:1: For the end; a psalm for David.
verses.20:2: Lord, in Your power the king will be glad, and over Your salvation he will exult greatly.
verses.20:3: You gave him the desire of his soul, and You did not deprive him of the petition of his lips. Interlude.
verses.20:4: For You met him beforehand with blessings of goodness; You set on his head a crown of precious stone.
verses.20:5: He asked You for life, and You gave him length of days forever and ever.
verses.20:6: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You will place glory and majesty upon him.
verses.20:7: For You will give him a blessing forever and ever; You will gladden him in joy with Your presence.
verses.20:8: For the king hopes in the Lord, and in the mercy of the Most High he will certainly not be shaken.
verses.20:9: May Your hand be found by all Your enemies; may Your right hand find all those who hate You.
verses.20:10: You will make them like a furnace of fire at the time of Your presence; Lord, in Your anger You will throw them into confusion, and fire will devour them.
verses.20:11: You will destroy their fruit from the earth, and their seed from the sons of men.
verses.20:12: For they directed evil things against You; they devised a plan which they will certainly not be able to establish.
verses.20:13: For You will make them a back; in Your remnants You will prepare their face.
verses.20:14: Be exalted, Lord, in Your power; we will sing and make music to Your mighty deeds.
verses.21:1: For the end; concerning the morning aid. A psalm for David.
verses.21:2: God, my God, attend to me; why have You abandoned me? Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions.
verses.21:3: My God, I will cry out by day to You, and You will not hear; and by night, and not to folly for me.
verses.21:4: Yet You dwell in holy places, the praise of Israel.
verses.21:5: In You our fathers hoped; they hoped, and You rescued them.
verses.21:6: To You they cried out and were saved; in You they hoped and were not put to shame.
verses.21:7: But I am a worm and not a man, a reproach of man and an object of contempt to the people.
verses.21:8: All who look at me sneered at me; they spoke with their lips, they shook their head:
verses.21:9: "He hoped in the Lord; let Him rescue him; let Him save him, because He delights in him."
verses.21:10: For You are the One who drew me out from the womb, my hope from my mother's breasts.
verses.21:11: On You I was cast from the womb; from my mother's womb You are my God.
verses.21:12: Do not withdraw from me, for affliction is near, for there is no one who helps.
verses.21:13: Many calves encircled me; fat bulls hemmed me in.
verses.21:14: They opened their mouth against me, like a lion that seizes and roars.
verses.21:15: Like water I was poured out, and all my bones were scattered; my heart became like wax melting in the midst of my belly.
verses.21:16: My strength dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue has clung to my throat, and into the dust of death You brought me down.
verses.21:17: For many dogs surrounded me; a gathering of evildoers hemmed me in; they pierced my hands and feet.
verses.21:18: They counted all my bones; and they themselves observed and looked at me.
verses.21:19: They divided my garments among themselves, and for my clothing they cast a lot.
verses.21:20: But You, Lord, do not put my help far away; attend to my aid.
verses.21:21: Rescue my soul from the sword, and my only one from the hand of a dog.
verses.21:22: Save me from the mouth of a lion, and my lowliness from the horns of unicorns.
verses.21:23: I will recount Your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will sing hymns to You.
verses.21:24: You who fear the Lord, praise Him; all the seed of Jacob, glorify Him; let all the seed of Israel fear Him.
verses.21:25: For He did not treat with contempt nor loathe the petition of the poor, nor did He turn His face away from me; and when I cried out to Him, He heard me.
verses.21:26: From You is my praise in a great assembly; I will pay my vows before those who fear Him.
verses.21:27: The needy will eat and be filled, and those who seek Him out will praise the Lord; their hearts will live forever and ever.
verses.21:28: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will worship before Him;
verses.21:29: for the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and He Himself rules over the nations.
verses.21:30: All the fat ones of the earth ate and worshiped; all who go down into the earth will fall prostrate before Him, and my soul lives for Him.
verses.21:31: And my seed will serve Him; the coming generation will be declared to the Lord,
verses.21:32: and they will declare His righteousness to a people that will be born, whom the Lord made.
verses.22:1: A psalm for David. The Lord shepherds me, and nothing will be lacking to me.
verses.22:2: In a place of green pasture, there He has made me encamp; beside water of rest He has nurtured me.
verses.22:3: He has turned my soul back. He has guided me along paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
verses.22:4: For even if I go in the middle of the shadow of death, I will not fear evils, because You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they have comforted me.
verses.22:5: You have prepared a table before me in the face of those who afflict me; You have anointed my head richly with oil, and Your cup intoxicates like the strongest.
verses.22:6: And Your mercy will pursue me all the days of my life, and my dwelling will be in the house of the Lord for length of days.
verses.23:1: A psalm for David; for the first day of the week. To the Lord belong the earth and its fullness, the inhabited world and all who dwell in it.
verses.23:2: He Himself founded it upon the seas, and prepared it upon the rivers.
verses.23:3: Who will go up to the mountain of the Lord, and who will stand in His holy place?
verses.23:4: One innocent in hands and pure in heart, who has not taken his soul in vain, and has not sworn with deceit to his neighbor.
verses.23:5: This one will receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Savior.
verses.23:6: This is the generation of those who seek Him, of those who seek the face of the God of Jacob. Interlude.
verses.23:7: Lift up the gates, you rulers among you, and be lifted up, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
verses.23:8: Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and powerful, the Lord, powerful in war.
verses.23:9: Lift up the gates, you rulers among you, and be lifted up, eternal gates, and the King of glory will enter.
verses.23:10: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of powers, He Himself is this King of glory.
verses.24:1: A psalm for David. To You, Lord, I have lifted up my soul,
verses.24:2: my God. In You I have trusted; may I not be put to shame, nor let my enemies laugh at me.
verses.24:3: For indeed all who wait for You will never be put to shame; let those who act lawlessly without cause be shamed.
verses.24:4: Make Your ways known to me, Lord, and teach me Your paths;
verses.24:5: guide me to Your truth and teach me, for You are God my Savior, and for You I have waited all the day.
verses.24:6: Remember Your compassions and Your mercies, for they are from eternity.
verses.24:7: Do not remember the sins of my youth and of ignorance; according to Your mercy remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, Lord.
verses.24:8: Good and upright is the Lord; therefore He will instruct those who sin in the way.
verses.24:9: He will guide the gentle in judgment; He will teach the gentle His ways.
verses.24:10: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth to those who seek out His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.24:11: For the sake of Your name, Lord, You will pardon my sin, for it is great.
verses.24:12: Who is the man who fears the Lord? He will instruct him in the way that he chose.
verses.24:13: His soul will abide in good things, and his seed will inherit the land.
verses.24:14: The Lord is a stronghold for those who fear Him, and the name of the Lord belongs to those who fear Him, and His covenant is to be made known to them.
verses.24:15: My eyes are continually toward the Lord, for He Himself will draw my feet out of the snare.
verses.24:16: Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and poor.
verses.24:17: The afflictions of my heart have multiplied; bring me out of my distresses.
verses.24:18: See my lowliness and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
verses.24:19: See my enemies, for they have multiplied, and with an unjust hatred they have hated me.
verses.24:20: Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be put to shame, for I have hoped in You.
verses.24:21: Innocent and upright ones clung to me, for I waited for You, Lord.
verses.24:22: Redeem Israel, God, from all his afflictions.
verses.25:1: Of David. Judge me, Lord, for I have walked in my innocence, and hoping in the Lord, I will never be shaken.
verses.25:2: Examine me, Lord, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart by fire.
verses.25:3: For Your mercy is before my eyes, and I have been well-pleasing in Your truth.
verses.25:4: I have not sat with a council of vanity, and with lawbreakers I will never go in.
verses.25:5: I have hated an assembly of evildoers, and with the ungodly I will never sit.
verses.25:6: I will wash my hands among the innocent, and I will go around Your altar,
verses.25:7: to hear a voice of praise and to recount all Your wondrous works.
verses.25:8: Lord, I have loved the beauty of Your house and the place of the tent of Your glory.
verses.25:9: Do not destroy my soul together with the ungodly, or my life with men of blood,
verses.25:10: in whose hands are acts of lawlessness; their right hand has been filled with bribes.
verses.25:11: But I have walked in my innocence; redeem me and have mercy on me.
verses.25:12: For my foot has stood in uprightness; in assemblies I will bless You, Lord.
verses.26:1: Of David, before being anointed. The Lord is my illumination and my Savior; whom will I fear? The Lord is the defender of my life; of whom will I be fearful?
verses.26:2: When wrongdoers drew near against me to eat my flesh, those who afflict me and my enemies, they themselves grew weak and fell.
verses.26:3: If an army arrays itself against me, my heart will not fear; if war rises up against me, in this I hope.
verses.26:4: One thing I have asked from the Lord; this I will seek out: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze upon the delightfulness of the Lord and to visit His temple.
verses.26:5: For He hid me in a tent in the day of my troubles; He sheltered me in the hidden place of His tent; on a rock He lifted me up.
verses.26:6: And now, look, He has lifted up my head above my enemies; I went around and offered in His tent a sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and make music to the Lord.
verses.26:7: "Hear, Lord, my voice with which I have cried out; have mercy on me and hear me,"
verses.26:8: my heart said to You. I have sought out Your face; Your face, Lord, I will seek.
verses.26:9: Do not turn Your face away from me; do not turn aside in anger from Your servant. Become my helper; do not abandon me and do not disregard me, God my Savior.
verses.26:10: For my father and my mother abandoned me, but the Lord took me in.
verses.26:11: Set a law for me, Lord, in Your way, and guide me on a straight path because of my enemies.
verses.26:12: Do not hand me over to the souls of those who afflict me, for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and injustice has lied to itself.
verses.26:13: I will believe that I will see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.26:14: Wait patiently for the Lord; be brave, and let your heart grow strong, and wait patiently for the Lord.
verses.27:1: Of David. To You, Lord, I have cried out; my God, do not keep silent toward me, lest You keep silent toward me and I become like those who go down into a pit.
verses.27:2: Hear the voice of my plea when I plead to You, when I lift my hands toward Your holy temple.
verses.27:3: Do not drag my soul away with sinners, and do not destroy me together with those who work injustice, who speak peace with their neighbors, while evil things are in their hearts.
verses.27:4: Give to them according to their works and according to the wickedness of their practices; according to the works of their hands give to them; repay their recompense to them.
verses.27:5: Because they did not understand the works of the Lord and the works of His hands, You will tear them down and will never build them up.
verses.27:6: Blessed is the Lord, because He has heard the voice of my plea.
verses.27:7: The Lord is my helper and my defender; in Him my heart hoped, and I was helped, and my flesh flourished anew; and from my will I will give thanks to Him.
verses.27:8: The Lord is the strength of His people and the defender of the deliverances of His anointed one.
verses.27:9: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance, and shepherd them and raise them up forever.
verses.28:1: A psalm for David, of the closing festival of the tent. Bring to the Lord, sons of God, bring to the Lord young rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor,
verses.28:2: bring to the Lord glory for His name; worship the Lord in His holy court.
verses.28:3: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thundered, the Lord is over many waters.
verses.28:4: The voice of the Lord is in strength; the voice of the Lord is in majesty.
verses.28:5: The voice of the Lord shattering cedars; the Lord will shatter the cedars of Lebanon,
verses.28:6: and He will grind them fine like the calf, Lebanon; and the beloved one like a young unicorn.
verses.28:7: The voice of the Lord splitting a flame of fire.
verses.28:8: The voice of the Lord shaking a wilderness; the Lord will shake the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.28:9: The voice of the Lord strengthening deer, and He will lay bare forests; and in His temple everyone says, "Glory."
verses.28:10: The Lord will settle the flood; and the Lord will sit as king forever.
verses.28:11: The Lord will give strength to His people; the Lord will bless His people in peace.
verses.29:1: For the end; a psalm of a song of the dedication of the house, of David.
verses.29:2: I will exalt You, Lord, because You upheld me and did not make my enemies glad over me.
verses.29:3: Lord my God, I cried out to You, and You healed me;
verses.29:4: Lord, You brought up my soul from Hades; You saved me from those going down into a pit.
verses.29:5: Sing praise to the Lord, His devout ones, and give thanks to the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.29:6: For wrath is in His anger, and life is in His will; in the evening weeping will lodge, and in the morning, exultation.
verses.29:7: As for me, I said in my prosperity, "I will by no means be shaken forever."
verses.29:8: Lord, in Your will grant power to my beauty; but You turned away Your face, and I became troubled.
verses.29:9: To You, Lord, I will cry out, and to my God I will make supplication.
verses.29:10: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down into corruption? Will dust give thanks to You, or will it declare Your truth?
verses.29:11: The Lord heard and had mercy on me; the Lord became my helper.
verses.29:12: You turned my mourning into joy for me; You tore apart my sackcloth and wrapped me in gladness,
verses.29:13: so that my glory may sing praise to You and I may by no means be pierced with grief. Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
verses.30:1: For the end; a psalm for David, of dismay.
verses.30:2: In You, Lord, I have hoped; may I not be put to shame forever; in Your righteousness deliver me and rescue me.
verses.30:3: Incline Your ear to me; hurry to rescue me. Be to me a protecting God and a house of refuge to save me.
verses.30:4: For You are my stronghold and my refuge, and for the sake of Your name You will guide me and nourish me.
verses.30:5: You will bring me out of this snare which they hid for me, for You are my protector.
verses.30:6: Into Your hands I will entrust my spirit; You redeemed me, Lord, the God of truth.
verses.30:7: You have hated those who observe futile things in vain, but I have hoped in the Lord.
verses.30:8: I will exult and be glad in Your mercy, because You looked upon my humiliation; You saved my soul out of distresses,
verses.30:9: and You did not shut me up into the hands of an enemy; You set my feet in a spacious place.
verses.30:10: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am distressed; my eye was troubled in anger, my soul and my belly.
verses.30:11: For my life failed in pain, and my years in groanings; my strength grew weak in poverty, and my bones were troubled.
verses.30:12: Because of all my enemies I became a reproach, and exceedingly so to my neighbors, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who saw me outside fled from me.
verses.30:13: I was forgotten like a dead man from the heart; I became like a ruined vessel.
verses.30:14: For I heard the slander of many dwelling all around; when they were gathered together against me, they plotted to take my life.
verses.30:15: But I have hoped in You, Lord; I said, "You are my God."
verses.30:16: In Your hands are my lots; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
verses.30:17: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; save me in Your mercy.
verses.30:18: Lord, may I not be put to shame, because I called upon You; may the ungodly be put to shame and be brought down to Hades.
verses.30:19: Let the deceitful lips become mute, which speak lawlessness against the righteous in pride and contempt.
verses.30:20: How great is the abundance of Your goodness, Lord, which You hid for those who fear You; You accomplished it for those who hope in You before the sons of men.
verses.30:21: You will hide them in the hiding place of Your presence from the turmoil of men; You will shelter them in a tent from the dispute of tongues.
verses.30:22: Blessed be the Lord, for He made His mercy wondrous in a fortified city.
verses.30:23: As for me, I said in my dismay, "Then I have been cast away from the sight of Your eyes." Therefore You heard, Lord, the voice of my supplication when I cried out to You.
verses.30:24: Love the Lord, all His devout ones, for the Lord seeks out truths, and repays those who excessively practice pride.
verses.30:25: Be courageous, and let your heart be strengthened, all who hope in the Lord.
verses.31:1: Of understanding, for David. Blessed are those whose lawless deeds were forgiven, and whose sins were covered over.
verses.31:2: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will by no means reckon against him, nor is there deceit in his mouth.
verses.31:3: Because I kept silent, my bones grew old from my crying out all day long.
verses.31:4: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; I was turned into misery while a thorn was driven in. Interlude.
verses.31:5: I made my sin known, and I did not cover my lawlessness; I said, "I will confess my sin against myself to the Lord," and You forgave the ungodliness of my heart. Interlude.
verses.31:6: For this every devout one will pray to You at a fitting time; yet in a flood of many waters, they will not draw near to him.
verses.31:7: You are my refuge from the affliction that encompasses me; my exultation, redeem me from those who have surrounded me. Interlude.
verses.31:8: I will give you understanding and instruct you in this way in which you will go; I will fix My eyes upon you.
verses.31:9: Do not become like a horse and a mule, which have no understanding; with bridle and muzzle curb the jaws of those who do not draw near to you.
verses.31:10: Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy will surround the one who hopes in the Lord.
verses.31:11: Be glad in the Lord and exult, you righteous; and boast, all you who are upright in heart.
verses.32:1: For David. Exult, you righteous, in the Lord; praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.32:2: Give thanks to the Lord with a lyre; with a ten-stringed harp make music to Him.
verses.32:3: Sing to Him a new song; make music skillfully with a joyful shout.
verses.32:4: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all His works are in faithfulness.
verses.32:5: He loves compassion and justice; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.
verses.32:6: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made firm, and by the breath of His mouth all their power.
verses.32:7: He gathers the waters of the sea as in a wineskin; He puts the deeps in storehouses.
verses.32:8: Let all the earth fear the Lord, and because of Him let all who dwell in the world be shaken.
verses.32:9: For He spoke, and they came into being; He commanded, and they were created.
verses.32:10: The Lord scatters the counsels of the nations; He nullifies the thoughts of the peoples, and He nullifies the counsels of rulers.
verses.32:11: But the counsel of the Lord remains forever, the thoughts of His heart from generations to generations.
verses.32:12: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, a people whom He chose as an inheritance for Himself.
verses.32:13: From heaven the Lord looked down; He saw all the sons of men.
verses.32:14: From His prepared dwelling place He looked down upon all who dwell on the earth,
verses.32:15: the One who formed their hearts individually, the One who understands all their works.
verses.32:16: A king is not saved by great power, and a giant will not be saved by the abundance of his strength.
verses.32:17: A horse is false for salvation, and by the abundance of its power it will not be saved.
verses.32:18: Look, the eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear Him, those who hope in His mercy,
verses.32:19: to deliver their souls from death and to nourish them in famine.
verses.32:20: Our soul waits patiently for the Lord, for He is our helper and protector.
verses.32:21: For in Him our heart will be glad, and in His holy name we have hoped.
verses.32:22: May Your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we have hoped in You.
verses.33:1: For David, when he altered his face before Abimelech, and he sent him away, and he departed.
verses.33:2: I will bless the Lord at all times; continually His praise is in my mouth.
verses.33:3: In the Lord my soul will be praised; let the meek hear and be glad.
verses.33:4: Magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt His name together.
verses.33:5: I sought out the Lord, and He listened to me, and He delivered me from all my sojournings.
verses.33:6: Come near to Him and be enlightened, and your faces will by no means be put to shame.
verses.33:7: This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him and saved him out of all his afflictions.
verses.33:8: The angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear Him and will deliver them.
verses.33:9: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who hopes in Him.
verses.33:10: Fear the Lord, all His holy ones, for there is no lack for those who fear Him.
verses.33:11: The rich became poor and went hungry, but those who seek out the Lord will not come short of any good thing. Interlude.
verses.33:12: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.33:13: Who is the person who desires life, loving to see good days?
verses.33:14: Restrain your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.33:15: Turn aside from evil and do what is good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.33:16: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are toward their supplication.
verses.33:17: But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil things, to wipe out their remembrance from the earth.
verses.33:18: The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them and delivered them out of all their afflictions.
verses.33:19: The Lord is near to those who are broken in heart, and He will save the humble in spirit.
verses.33:20: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, and out of them all He will deliver them.
verses.33:21: The Lord guards all their bones; not one of them will be broken.
verses.33:22: The death of sinners is evil, and those who hate the righteous one will incur guilt.
verses.33:23: The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants, and all who hope in Him will by no means incur guilt.
verses.34:1: For David. Judge, Lord, those who wrong me; wage war against those who wage war against me.
verses.34:2: Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise up to my help.
verses.34:3: Pour out a sword and close in against those who pursue me; say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
verses.34:4: May those who seek my soul be shamed and disgraced; may those who devise evil against me be turned backward and utterly shamed.
verses.34:5: Let them become like dust before the face of the wind, with an angel of the Lord pressing them hard.
verses.34:6: Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, with an angel of the Lord pursuing them.
verses.34:7: For without cause they hid for me the destruction of their snare; without reason they reproached my soul.
verses.34:8: Let a snare come upon them which they do not know, and let the trap which they hid seize them; and into the snare itself they will fall.
verses.34:9: But my soul will exult in the Lord; it will take delight in His salvation.
verses.34:10: All my bones will say, "Lord, who is like You, rescuing a poor man from the hand of those stronger than he, and a poor and needy man from those who plunder him?"
verses.34:11: Rising up, unjust witnesses questioned me about things I did not know.
verses.34:12: They were repaying me evil for good, and childlessness to my soul.
verses.34:13: But I, when they were troubling me, would clothe myself with sackcloth and would humble my soul with fasting; and my prayer will return to my bosom.
verses.34:14: As to a neighbor, as to our brother, so I acted pleasingly; like one mourning and downcast, so I humbled myself.
verses.34:15: And against me they rejoiced and gathered together; scourges gathered together against me, and I did not know; they were torn apart and felt no remorse.
verses.34:16: They tested me, they mocked me with mockery, they gnashed their teeth against me.
verses.34:17: Lord, when will You look on? Restore my soul from their malice, my only one from lions.
verses.34:18: I will give thanks to You, Lord, in a great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise You.
verses.34:19: May they not gloat over me, those who are hostile to me without reason, those who hate me without cause and wink with their eyes.
verses.34:20: For to me they were speaking peaceful things, yet in anger they were devising deceits.
verses.34:21: And they opened wide their mouth against me; they said, "Aha, aha, our eyes have seen!"
verses.34:22: You have seen, Lord; do not remain silent; Lord, do not withdraw from me.
verses.34:23: Rouse Yourself, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my cause.
verses.34:24: Judge me, Lord, according to Your righteousness, Lord my God, and may they not gloat over me.
verses.34:25: May they not say in their hearts, "Aha, aha, for our soul!" nor may they say, "We have swallowed him up."
verses.34:26: May those who gloat over my misfortunes be shamed and disgraced together; let those who speak boastfully against me clothe themselves with shame and disgrace.
verses.34:27: May those who desire my righteousness exult and rejoice; and let those who desire the peace of His servant say continually, "May the Lord be magnified."
verses.34:28: And my tongue will rehearse Your righteousness, all the day Your praise.
verses.35:1: For the end; for the servant of the Lord, David.
verses.35:2: The lawless one speaks within himself of sinning; there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.35:3: For he acted deceitfully before him, to find his lawlessness and hate it.
verses.35:4: The words of his mouth are lawlessness and deceit; he was unwilling to understand so as to do good.
verses.35:5: He devised lawlessness upon his bed; he took his stand on every way that is not good, and he did not loathe evil.
verses.35:6: Lord, Your mercy is in heaven, and Your truth reaches to the clouds.
verses.35:7: And righteousness is like mountains of God; Your judgments are like a great abyss. You will save men and beasts, Lord,
verses.35:8: as You have multiplied Your mercy, God; and the sons of men will hope in the shelter of Your wings.
verses.35:9: They will be intoxicated with the fatness of Your house, and You will give them to drink from the torrent of Your delight.
verses.35:10: For with You is a spring of life; in Your light we will see light.
verses.35:11: Extend Your mercy to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.35:12: Let not a foot of arrogance come upon me, and may a hand of sinners not shake me.
verses.35:13: There all who work lawlessness have fallen; they have been thrust out and will by no means be able to stand.
verses.36:1: Of David. Do not be envious of those who do evil, nor be jealous of those who practice lawlessness.
verses.36:2: For like grass they will quickly dry up, and like herbs of green grass they will quickly fall away.
verses.36:3: Hope in the Lord and practice goodness, and dwell in the land, and you will be pastured on its wealth.
verses.36:4: Delight in the Lord, and He will give you the requests of your heart.
verses.36:5: Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in Him, and He Himself will act.
verses.36:6: And He will bring out your righteousness like light, and your judgment like midday.
verses.36:7: Submit to the Lord and implore Him; do not be envious of the one who prospers in his life, of a man who practices transgressions.
verses.36:8: Cease from anger and abandon wrath; do not be envious so as to do evil.
verses.36:9: For those who do evil will be utterly destroyed, but those who wait for the Lord, they themselves will inherit the land.
verses.36:10: And yet a little while, and a sinner will by no means exist; and you will look for his place, and you will by no means find it.
verses.36:11: But the meek will inherit the land, and will delight in an abundance of peace.
verses.36:12: The sinner will closely watch the righteous one, and will gnash his teeth at him.
verses.36:13: But the Lord will laugh at him, for He foresees that his day will come.
verses.36:14: The sinners drew a sword, they bent their bow, to bring down the poor and needy, to slaughter those upright in heart.
verses.36:15: May their sword enter into their heart, and may their bows be broken.
verses.36:16: Better is a little for the righteous one than the abundant wealth of sinners.
verses.36:17: For the arms of sinners will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.
verses.36:18: The Lord knows the ways of the blameless, and their inheritance will be forever.
verses.36:19: They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they will be satisfied.
verses.36:20: For the sinners will perish, and the enemies of the Lord, at the very moment they were glorified and exalted, vanishing like smoke, vanished.
verses.36:21: The sinner borrows and will not repay, but the righteous one shows compassion and gives.
verses.36:22: For those who bless Him will inherit the land, but those who curse Him will be utterly destroyed.
verses.36:23: By the Lord the steps of a man are directed, and He will take pleasure in his way.
verses.36:24: When he falls, he will not be dashed down, for the Lord supports his hand.
verses.36:25: I was young, and indeed I have grown old, and I have not seen a righteous one abandoned, nor his seed seeking bread.
verses.36:26: All day long he shows mercy and lends, and his seed will be a blessing.
verses.36:27: Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever and ever.
verses.36:28: For the Lord loves justice, and He will not abandon His devout ones; they will be kept forever. The blameless will be vindicated, and the seed of the ungodly will be utterly destroyed.
verses.36:29: But the righteous will inherit the land, and they will dwell upon it forever and ever.
verses.36:30: The mouth of a righteous one will meditate on wisdom, and his tongue will speak justice.
verses.36:31: The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.
verses.36:32: The sinner will observe the righteous one, and he seeks to put him to death.
verses.36:33: But the Lord will by no means abandon him into his hands, nor will He condemn him when he is on trial with him.
verses.36:34: Wait for the Lord and keep His way, and He will exalt you to inherit the land; when sinners are utterly destroyed, you will see it.
verses.36:35: I saw an ungodly one highly exalted and lifted up like the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.36:36: And I passed by, and look, he was no more; and I sought him, and his place was not found.
verses.36:37: Keep innocence and see uprightness, for there is a remnant for a peaceable man.
verses.36:38: But the transgressors will be utterly destroyed together; the remnants of the ungodly will be utterly destroyed.
verses.36:39: But the salvation of the righteous is with the Lord, and He is their protector in a time of affliction.
verses.36:40: And the Lord will help them and deliver them, and He will rescue them from sinners and save them, because they hoped in Him.
verses.37:1: A psalm for David; for remembrance concerning the Sabbath.
verses.37:2: Lord, do not reprove me in Your wrath, nor discipline me in Your anger.
verses.37:3: For Your arrows have stuck fast in me, and You have pressed Your hand down upon me.
verses.37:4: And there is no healing in my flesh because of Your anger; there is no peace for my bones because of my sins.
verses.37:5: For my lawless deeds have risen above my head; like a heavy burden they have weighed heavily upon me.
verses.37:6: My wounds stank and rotted because of my foolishness.
verses.37:7: I suffered misery and was utterly bowed down; all day long I walked about with a gloomy face.
verses.37:8: For my soul has been filled with mockeries, and there is no healing in my flesh.
verses.37:9: I was afflicted and humbled exceedingly; I was roaring from the groaning of my heart.
verses.37:10: And before You is all my desire, and my groaning was not hidden from You.
verses.37:11: My heart has been troubled, my strength has abandoned me, and the light of my eyes is not with me.
verses.37:12: My friends and my neighbors drew near and stood opposite me, and those nearest to me stood far off.
verses.37:13: And those who seek my life used violence, and those who seek evil against me spoke futile things, and they meditated on deceits all day long.
verses.37:14: But I, like a deaf man, did not hear, and was like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
verses.37:15: And I became like a man who does not hear, and who has no reproofs in his mouth.
verses.37:16: For in You I have hoped, Lord; You will hear, Lord my God.
verses.37:17: For I said, "May my enemies never gloat over me," and when my feet were shaken, they spoke boastfully against me.
verses.37:18: For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is before me continually.
verses.37:19: For I will declare my lawlessness, and I will be anxious over my sin.
verses.37:20: But my enemies live and have grown stronger than I, and those who hate me unjustly have multiplied.
verses.37:21: Those who repay evil for good were slandering me, because I pursued righteousness.
verses.37:22: Do not abandon me, Lord; my God, do not depart from me.
verses.37:23: Attend to my help, Lord of my salvation.
verses.38:1: For the end, for Jeduthun; a song for David.
verses.38:2: I said, "I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue." I set a guard over my mouth while the sinner stood against me.
verses.38:3: I became mute and was humbled and kept silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
verses.38:4: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation a fire will be kindled; I spoke with my tongue:
verses.38:5: "Make known to me, Lord, my end, and what the number of my days is, so that I may know what I lack.
verses.38:6: Look, You have made my days old, and my existence is as nothing before You; yet all things are futility, every living man. Interlude.
verses.38:7: Surely man passes through as an image, yet they are troubled in vain; he stores up treasure and does not know for whom he will gather these things.
verses.38:8: And now, what is my endurance? Is it not the Lord? And my existence is from You.
verses.38:9: Deliver me from all my lawless deeds; You have made me a reproach to a fool.
verses.38:10: I became mute and did not open my mouth, because You are the One who made me.
verses.38:11: Remove Your scourges from me; because of the strength of Your hand I have fainted.
verses.38:12: With reproofs for lawlessness You disciplined man, and You melted away his soul like a spider's web; yet every man is troubled in vain. Interlude.
verses.38:13: Hear my prayer and my supplication; give ear to my tears. Do not remain silent, because I am a stranger on the earth and a temporary resident, just as all my fathers were.
verses.38:14: Relent toward me so that I may be refreshed before I depart and exist no more."
verses.39:1: For the end; a psalm for David.
verses.39:2: Waiting, I waited for the Lord, and He gave attention to me and heard my supplication;
verses.39:3: and He brought me up out of a pit of misery and from muddy clay, and He set my feet on a rock and directed my steps;
verses.39:4: and He put a new song into my mouth, a hymn to our God. Many will see and fear, and will hope in the Lord.
verses.39:5: Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, and who has not looked to futilities and false frenzies.
verses.39:6: You have made Your wonders many, Lord my God, and there is no one who will be likened to Your thoughts; I declared and spoke; they have multiplied beyond number.
verses.39:7: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but You fashioned a body for me; a whole burnt offering and a sin offering You did not require.
verses.39:8: Then I said, "Look, I have come; in the scroll of a book it is written about me;
verses.39:9: I have desired to do Your will, my God, and Your law is in the midst of my heart."
verses.39:10: I proclaimed good news of righteousness in a great assembly; look, I will certainly not restrain my lips. Lord, You have known
verses.39:11: my righteousness; I did not hide Your truth in my heart, and I spoke of Your salvation; I did not hide Your mercy and Your truth from a vast congregation.
verses.39:12: But You, Lord, do not keep Your compassions far from me; Your mercy and Your truth have continually upheld me.
verses.39:13: For evils of which there is no number have surrounded me; my lawless deeds have overtaken me, and I was not able to see; they have multiplied beyond the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
verses.39:14: Be pleased, Lord, to deliver me; Lord, give attention to helping me.
verses.39:15: May those who seek my soul to take it away be put to shame and disgraced together; may those who desire evil for me be turned backward and disgraced.
verses.39:16: Let those who say to me, "Aha, aha!" immediately receive their shame.
verses.39:17: May all who seek You exult and be glad in You, Lord, and let those who continually love Your salvation say continually, "May the Lord be magnified!"
verses.39:18: But I am poor and needy; the Lord will care for me. You are my helper and my defender; my God, do not delay.
verses.40:1: For the end; a psalm for David.
verses.40:2: Blessed is the one who shows understanding toward the poor and needy; in an evil day the Lord will deliver him.
verses.40:3: May the Lord guard him and pronounce him blessed on the earth, and may He not hand him over into the hands of his enemy.
verses.40:4: May the Lord help him on his bed of pain; You turned his entire bed in his illness.
verses.40:5: I said, "Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, because I have sinned against You."
verses.40:6: My enemies spoke evil things against me: "When will he die and his name be lost?"
verses.40:7: And if he came in to see, he would speak in vain; his heart gathered lawlessness for himself; he would go outside and speak
verses.40:8: together against me. All my enemies were whispering against me; they were devising evil things against me;
verses.40:9: they laid down a lawless word against me: "Will the one who sleeps not rise up again?"
verses.40:10: For even the man of my peace, in whom I hoped, the one who ate my bread, has magnified treachery against me.
verses.40:11: But You, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.
verses.40:12: By this I have known that You have delighted in me, because my enemy will certainly not gloat over me.
verses.40:13: As for me, You upheld me because of innocence, and You established me before You forever.
verses.40:14: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity. May it be so, may it be so.
verses.41:1: For the end; for understanding, to the sons of Korah.
verses.41:2: Just as the deer yearns for the springs of water, so my soul yearns for You, God.
verses.41:3: My soul has thirsted for the living God; when will I come and appear before the face of God?
verses.41:4: My tears have become bread day and night, while it is said to me each day, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:5: These things I remembered, and I poured out my soul upon myself; for I will pass through the place of a wondrous tent as far as the house of God, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving, a sound of those celebrating a festival.
verses.41:6: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you greatly trouble me? Hope in God, for I will give thanks to Him; the salvation of my face
verses.41:7: is my God. Within myself my soul has been troubled; therefore I will remember You from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from a small mountain.
verses.41:8: Abyss calls upon abyss at the voice of Your waterfalls; all Your billows and Your waves have passed over me.
verses.41:9: By day the Lord will command His mercy, and by night He will make it known; with me is a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.41:10: I will say to God, "You are my protector; why have You forgotten me? Why do I walk about downcast while my enemy oppresses me?"
verses.41:11: In crushing my bones, those who oppress me reproached me, while they say to me each day, "Where is your God?"
verses.41:12: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you greatly trouble me? Hope in God, for I will give thanks to Him; the salvation of my face is my God.
verses.42:1: A psalm for David. Judge me, God, and decide my case against an unholy nation; rescue me from an unjust and deceitful man.
verses.42:2: For You are God, my strength; why have You rejected me? And why do I walk about downcast while my enemy oppresses me?
verses.42:3: Send out Your light and Your truth; they led me and brought me to Your holy mountain and to Your dwellings.
verses.42:4: And I will go in to the altar of God, to God who gladdens my youth; I will give thanks to You, Lord my God, with a lyre.
verses.42:5: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you greatly trouble me? Hope in God, for I will give thanks to Him; the salvation of my face is my God.
verses.43:1: For the end; to the sons of Korah, for understanding, a psalm.
verses.43:2: God, with our ears we have heard; our fathers told us the work that You did in their days, in ancient days.
verses.43:3: Your hand utterly destroyed nations, and You planted them; You afflicted peoples and drove them out.
verses.43:4: For they did not inherit the land by their sword, and their arm did not save them, but Your right hand and Your arm and the illumination of Your face, because You were well pleased with them.
verses.43:5: You Yourself are my King and my God, the One who commands the deliverances of Jacob.
verses.43:6: In You we will gore our enemies, and in Your name we will treat as nothing those who rise up against us.
verses.43:7: For I will not hope in my bow, and my sword will not save me.
verses.43:8: For You saved us from those who oppress us, and You put to shame those who hate us.
verses.43:9: In God we will be praised all day long, and in Your name we will give thanks forever. Interlude.
verses.43:10: But now You have rejected us and put us to shame, and You will not go out with our armies.
verses.43:11: You turned us back before our enemies, and those who hate us were plundering for themselves.
verses.43:12: You gave us like sheep for food, and You scattered us among the nations.
verses.43:13: You sold Your people without a price, and there was no abundance in their shouts.
verses.43:14: You made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and a derision to those around us.
verses.43:15: You made us into a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.43:16: All day long my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.43:17: because of the voice of one who reproaches and reviles, because of the presence of an enemy and a pursuer.
verses.43:18: All these things have come upon us, yet we have not forgotten You, and we have not acted unjustly in Your covenant;
verses.43:19: and our heart has not turned back, yet You turned our paths aside from Your way.
verses.43:20: For You humbled us in a place of affliction, and the shadow of death covered us over.
verses.43:21: If we have forgotten the name of our God, and if we have spread out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.43:22: will not God search out these things? For He Himself knows the hidden things of the heart.
verses.43:23: For on Your account we are put to death all day long; we were counted like sheep for slaughter.
verses.43:24: Awake! Why do You sleep, Lord? Arise, and do not reject us to the end.
verses.43:25: Why do You turn Your face away? Do You forget our poverty and our oppression?
verses.43:26: For our soul has been humbled to the dust; our belly has clung to the ground.
verses.43:27: Arise, Lord, help us, and redeem us on account of Your name.
verses.44:1: For the end, concerning those who will be changed; for the sons of Korah, for understanding; a song concerning the beloved.
verses.44:2: My heart poured forth a good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue is the reed pen of a swift-writing scribe.
verses.44:3: You are lovely in beauty beyond the sons of men; grace was poured out on your lips; therefore God blessed you forever.
verses.44:4: Fasten your sword on your thigh, Mighty One, with your loveliness and your beauty,
verses.44:5: and press on, and prosper, and reign for the sake of truth and meekness and righteousness, and your right hand will guide you marvelously.
verses.44:6: Your arrows are sharpened, Mighty One; peoples will fall beneath you in the heart of the king's enemies.
verses.44:7: Your throne, God, is forever and ever; a scepter of equity is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.44:8: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, Your God, anointed You with oil of exultation beyond Your companions.
verses.44:9: Myrrh and stacte and cassia are from your garments, from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.
verses.44:10: Daughters of kings are in your honor; the queen stood at your right hand, arrayed in attire interwoven with gold, adorned in varied colors.
verses.44:11: Listen, daughter, and see, and incline your ear, and forget your people and the house of your father.
verses.44:12: For the king desired your beauty, because he is your lord.
verses.44:13: And daughters of Tyre will bow down to him with gifts; the rich of the people of the earth will implore your face.
verses.44:14: All the glory of her, the daughter of the king of Heshbon, is arrayed in golden fringes, adorned in varied colors.
verses.44:15: Virgins will be brought to the king after her; those near her will be brought to you.
verses.44:16: They will be brought with gladness and exultation; they will be led into the temple of the king.
verses.44:17: In place of your fathers, sons were born to you; you will appoint them rulers over all the earth.
verses.44:18: They will remember your name in every generation and generation; therefore peoples will give thanks to you forever and forever and ever.
verses.45:1: For the end; for the sons of Korah, concerning the hidden things, a psalm.
verses.45:2: Our God is a refuge and strength, a helper in afflictions that found us exceedingly.
verses.45:3: Therefore we will not fear when the earth is troubled and mountains are moved into the hearts of the seas.
verses.45:4: Their waters roared and were troubled; the mountains were troubled by His might. Interlude.
verses.45:5: The rushing currents of the river gladden the city of God; the Most High sanctified His tabernacle.
verses.45:6: God is in its midst; it will not be shaken; God will help it with His presence.
verses.45:7: Nations were troubled, kingdoms tottered; He gave His voice, the earth was shaken.
verses.45:8: The Lord of powers is with us; our protector is the God of Jacob. Interlude.
verses.45:9: Come, see the works of the Lord, what wonders He set on the earth.
verses.45:10: Removing wars to the ends of the earth, He will shatter the bow and break the weapon, and He will burn up shields in fire.
verses.45:11: "Be at rest, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."
verses.45:12: The Lord of powers is with us; our protector is the God of Jacob.
verses.46:1: For the end; for the sons of Korah, a psalm.
verses.46:2: All nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation.
verses.46:3: For the Lord Most High is fearsome, a great king over all the earth.
verses.46:4: He subjected peoples to us, and nations under our feet.
verses.46:5: He chose for us His inheritance, the beauty of Jacob which He loved. Interlude.
verses.46:6: God ascended with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.46:7: Sing praise to our God, sing praise; sing praise to our king, sing praise.
verses.46:8: For God is king of all the earth; sing praise with understanding.
verses.46:9: God reigned over the nations; God sits on His holy throne.
verses.46:10: Rulers of peoples were gathered together with the God of Abraham, for God's mighty ones of the earth were exceedingly lifted up.
verses.47:1: A psalm of a song for the sons of Korah, on the second day of the week.
