verses.47:2: Great is the Lord and exceedingly worthy of praise in the city of our God, His holy mountain,
verses.47:3: well-rooted, the exultation of all the earth; the mountains of Zion, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.47:4: God is known in her citadels when He comes to her aid.
verses.47:5: For look, the kings assembled; they came together.
verses.47:6: They themselves saw and thus marveled; they were troubled, they were shaken.
verses.47:7: Trembling took hold of them; there were labor pains like those of a woman giving birth.
verses.47:8: With a violent wind You will shatter ships of Tarshish.
verses.47:9: Just as we heard, so we saw in the city of the Lord of powers, in the city of our God; God founded her forever. Interlude.
verses.47:10: We have received, God, Your mercy in the midst of Your people.
verses.47:11: According to Your name, God, so also is Your praise to the ends of the earth; full of righteousness is Your right hand.
verses.47:12: Let Mount Zion be glad, let the daughters of Judea exult because of Your judgments, Lord.
verses.47:13: Go around Zion and encircle her; recount it in her towers.
verses.47:14: Set your hearts on her strength, and divide up her citadels, so that you may recount it to another generation.
verses.47:15: For this is our God forever, and forever and ever.
verses.48:1: For the end: a psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.48:2: Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all who inhabit the world,
verses.48:3: both the earthborn and the sons of men, rich and poor together.
verses.48:4: My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart, understanding.
verses.48:5: I will incline my ear to a parable; I will open my riddle with a harp.
verses.48:6: Why do I fear in an evil day? The lawlessness of my heel will surround me,
verses.48:7: those who trust in their strength and boast in the abundance of their wealth.
verses.48:8: A brother does not redeem; will a man redeem? He will not give to God his atonement,
verses.48:9: nor the price of the redemption of his soul; and he labored forever,
verses.48:10: and he will live to the end, for he will not see destruction,
verses.48:11: when he sees the wise dying. Together the senseless and the foolish will perish, and they will leave their wealth to strangers.
verses.48:12: And their tombs are their houses forever, their dwellings to generation and generation; they called their names upon their lands.
verses.48:13: And a man who is in honor did not understand; he was compared to the senseless beasts and became like them.
verses.48:14: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them, and after these things they will bless with their mouth. Interlude.
verses.48:15: Like sheep they were placed in Hades; death shepherds them, and the upright will rule over them in the morning, and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.
verses.48:16: Yet God will redeem my soul from the hand of Hades, when He receives me. Interlude.
verses.48:17: Do not fear when a man becomes rich, and when the glory of his house is multiplied;
verses.48:18: for when he dies he will not take all things, nor will his glory go down with him.
verses.48:19: For his soul will be blessed in his life; he will give thanks to You when You do good to him.
verses.48:20: He will enter as far as the generation of his fathers; forever he will not see light.
verses.48:21: A man who is in honor did not understand; he was compared to the senseless beasts and became like them.
verses.49:1: A psalm for Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and called the earth from the rising of the sun and as far as sunset.
verses.49:2: Out of Zion is the splendor of His beauty.
verses.49:3: God will come visibly, our God, and He will not keep silent; fire will burn before Him, and around Him is a very fierce tempest.
verses.49:4: He will summon heaven above and the earth, to judge His people.
verses.49:5: Gather to Him His devout ones, those who make His covenant over sacrifices.
verses.49:6: And the heavens will proclaim His righteousness, for God is judge. Interlude.
verses.49:7: "Hear, My people, and I will speak to you; Israel, and I testify to you: I am God, your God.
verses.49:8: Not because of your sacrifices will I rebuke you, and your whole burnt offerings are continually before Me.
verses.49:9: I will not accept calves from your house, nor male goats from your flocks.
verses.49:10: For Mine are all the wild beasts of the forest, livestock on the mountains and oxen.
verses.49:11: I know all the birds of heaven, and the beauty of the field is with Me.
verses.49:12: If I become hungry, I will certainly not tell you; for Mine is the world and its fullness.
verses.49:13: Will I eat the flesh of bulls? Or will I drink the blood of goats?
verses.49:14: Sacrifice to God a sacrifice of praise, and pay your vows to the Most High;
verses.49:15: and call upon Me in a day of distress, and I will deliver you, and you will glorify Me." Interlude.
verses.49:16: But to the sinner God said, "Why do you recount My statutes, and take up My covenant through your mouth?
verses.49:17: Yet you hated discipline and kept casting My words behind you.
verses.49:18: If you saw a thief, you ran along with him, and with adulterers you set your portion.
verses.49:19: Your mouth multiplied evil, and your tongue wove deceit.
verses.49:20: Sitting down, you spoke against your brother, and against the son of your mother you placed a stumbling block.
verses.49:21: These things you did, and I kept silent; you supposed lawlessness, that I would be like you. I will rebuke you and set them before your face.
verses.49:22: Understand these things now, you who forget God, otherwise He will snatch you away, and there will be no one who rescues.
verses.49:23: A sacrifice of praise will glorify Me, and there is the way by which I will show him the salvation of God."
verses.50:1: For the end: a psalm for David,
verses.50:2: when Nathan the prophet came to him, when he had gone in to Bathsheba.
verses.50:3: Have mercy on me, God, according to Your great mercy, and according to the abundance of Your compassions blot out my lawless deed.
verses.50:4: Wash me all the more from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.50:5: For I myself know my lawlessness, and my sin is before me continually.
verses.50:6: Against You alone I have sinned, and I have done what is evil before You, so that You may be justified in Your words and prevail when You are judged.
verses.50:7: For look, in lawless deeds I was conceived, and in sins my mother conceived me.
verses.50:8: For look, You have loved truth; You have made clear to me the unseen and hidden things of Your wisdom.
verses.50:9: You will sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; You will wash me, and I will be made whiter than snow.
verses.50:10: You will make me hear exultation and gladness; humbled bones will exult.
verses.50:11: Turn Your face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawless deeds.
verses.50:12: Create a clean heart in me, God, and renew an upright spirit in my inward parts.
verses.50:13: Do not cast me away from Your face, and do not remove Your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.50:14: Restore to me the exultation of Your salvation, and uphold me with a governing spirit.
verses.50:15: I will teach the lawless Your ways, and the ungodly will return to You.
verses.50:16: Rescue me from bloodshed, God, the God of my salvation; my tongue will exult in Your righteousness,
verses.50:17: Lord. You will open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
verses.50:18: For if You had desired a sacrifice, I would have given it; You will not take pleasure in whole burnt offerings.
verses.50:19: A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit; a broken and humbled heart God will not despise.
verses.50:20: Do good to Zion, Lord, in Your good pleasure, and let the walls of Jerusalem be built.
verses.50:21: Then You will take pleasure in a sacrifice of righteousness, an offering and whole burnt offerings; then they will offer up calves on Your altar.
verses.51:1: For the end: of understanding, for David,
verses.51:2: when Doeg the Idumean came and reported to Saul and said to him, "David has come into the house of Abimelech."
verses.51:3: Why do you boast in evil, mighty one—lawlessness all day long?
verses.51:4: Your tongue devised unrighteousness; like a sharpened razor, you worked deceit.
verses.51:5: You loved evil more than goodness, unrighteousness more than speaking righteousness. Interlude.
verses.51:6: You loved all the words of engulfment, a deceitful tongue.
verses.51:7: Therefore God will tear you down forever; may He pluck you out and banish you from a dwelling, and your root from the land of the living. Interlude.
verses.51:8: And the righteous will see and fear, and they will laugh at him and say,
verses.51:9: "Look, a man who did not make God his helper, but put his hope in the abundance of his wealth, and grew strong in his futility."
verses.51:10: But I am like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God; I have hoped in the mercy of God forever, and forever and ever.
verses.51:11: I will give thanks to You forever, because You have acted; and I will wait for Your name, for it is good before Your devout ones.
verses.52:1: For the end, concerning Mahalath: of understanding, for David.
verses.52:2: A fool said in his heart, "There is no God." They acted corruptly and became abominable in lawless deeds; there is no one who does good.
verses.52:3: God looked down from heaven upon the sons of men to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks out God.
verses.52:4: All turned aside; together they became useless; there is no one doing good, there is not even one.
verses.52:5: Will not all who work lawlessness know, those who eat My people as a meal of bread? They did not call upon God.
verses.52:6: There they will fear a fear where there was no fear, because God scattered the bones of people-pleasers; they were put to shame, because God despised them.
verses.52:7: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back the captivity of His people, Jacob will exult, and Israel will be glad.
verses.53:1: For the end, with hymns; of understanding, for David,
verses.53:2: when the Ziphites came; and he said to Saul, "Look, is David not hidden with us?"
verses.53:3: God, in Your name save me, and in Your power judge me.
verses.53:4: God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.53:5: For strangers rose up against me, and mighty ones sought my soul; they did not set God before them. Interlude.
verses.53:6: For look, God helps me, and the Lord is the upholder of my soul.
verses.53:7: He will turn back the evils upon my enemies; in Your truth utterly destroy them.
verses.53:8: Willingly I will sacrifice to You; I will give thanks to Your name, for it is good;
verses.53:9: for out of every affliction You delivered me, and my eye looked upon my enemies.
verses.54:1: For the end, with hymns; of understanding, for David.
verses.54:2: Give ear, God, to my prayer, and do not overlook my supplication,
verses.54:3: attend to me and hear me. I was grieved in my meditation, and I was troubled
verses.54:4: because of the voice of an enemy and because of the affliction of a sinner; for they turned lawlessness upon me, and in anger they held a grudge against me.
verses.54:5: My heart was troubled within me, and dread of death fell upon me.
verses.54:6: Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
verses.54:7: And I said, "Who will give me wings like those of a dove, and I will fly and rest?"
verses.54:8: Look, I went far away fleeing, and I lodged in the wilderness. Interlude.
verses.54:9: I was waiting for Him who saves me from faintheartedness and storm.
verses.54:10: Submerge, Lord, and divide their tongues, for I saw lawlessness and strife in the city.
verses.54:11: Day and night it will encircle her upon her walls; lawlessness and toil are in her midst,
verses.54:12: and injustice, and trouble and deceit did not depart from her squares.
verses.54:13: For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured it, and if the one who hates had spoken boastfully against me, I would have hidden from him.
verses.54:14: But you, a man of like soul, my guide and my acquaintance,
verses.54:15: who together sweetened meals; in the house of God we walked in harmony.
verses.54:16: Let death come upon them, and let them go down to Hades alive; for evils are in their dwellings, in their midst.
verses.54:17: I cried out to God, and the Lord heard me.
verses.54:18: Evening and morning and noon I will recount; I will announce, and He will hear my voice.
verses.54:19: He will redeem my soul in peace from those who draw near to me, for among many they were with me.
verses.54:20: God will hear and will humble them, He who exists before the ages. Interlude.
verses.54:21: For there is no exchange for them, and they did not fear God. He stretched out His hand in repaying; they profaned His covenant,
verses.54:22: they were scattered from the anger of His face, and his heart drew near; his words were made softer than oil, yet they are darts.
verses.54:23: Cast your anxiety upon the Lord, and He Himself will nourish you; He will never give shaking to the righteous one.
verses.54:24: But You, God, will bring them down into a pit of corruption; men of bloodshed and deceit will by no means reach half their days; but I will hope in You, Lord.
verses.55:1: For the end, concerning the people who have been removed far from the holy things; for David, for a pillar inscription, when the foreigners seized him in Gath.
verses.55:2: Have mercy on me, Lord, for man trampled on me; all day long, fighting, he afflicted me.
verses.55:3: My enemies trampled on me all day long from the height of the day; for many who fight against me
verses.55:4: will be afraid, but I will hope in You.
verses.55:5: In God I will praise my words all day long; in God I have hoped; I will not fear what flesh will do to me.
verses.55:6: All day long they detested my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.55:7: They will sojourn and hide; they themselves will watch my heel, just as I waited in my soul;
verses.55:8: On account of nothing You will save them; in anger You will bring peoples down. God,
verses.55:9: I declared my life to You; You set my tears before You, as also in Your promise.
verses.55:10: My enemies will turn back on whatever day I call upon You; look, I know that You are my God.
verses.55:11: In God I will praise an utterance, in God I will praise a word.
verses.55:12: In God I have hoped; I will not fear what man will do to me.
verses.55:13: In me, God, are the vows of praise that I will repay;
verses.55:14: for You delivered my soul from death, and my feet from slipping, so as to be well-pleasing before God in the light of the living.
verses.56:1: For the end; do not destroy; for David, for a pillar inscription, when he was fleeing from the presence of Saul into the cave.
verses.56:2: Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me, for my soul has trusted in You, and in the shadow of Your wings I will hope until lawlessness passes by.
verses.56:3: I will cry out to God the Most High, the God who has done good to me. Interlude.
verses.56:4: He sent out from heaven and saved me; He gave over to reproach those who trample me. God sent out His mercy and His truth,
verses.56:5: and rescued my soul from the midst of young lions. I lay down troubled. Sons of men: their teeth are a weapon and arrows, and their tongue is a sharp sword.
verses.56:6: Be exalted over the heavens, God, and may Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.56:7: They prepared traps for my feet, and they bowed down my soul; they dug a pit before my face, and they fell into it. Interlude.
verses.56:8: My heart is ready, God, my heart is ready; I will sing and make melody.
verses.56:9: Awake, my glory; awake, harp and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
verses.56:10: I will give thanks to You among peoples, Lord; I will make melody to You among nations,
verses.56:11: because Your mercy has been magnified up to the heavens, and Your truth up to the clouds.
verses.56:12: Be exalted over the heavens, God, and may Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.57:1: For the end; do not destroy; for David, for a pillar inscription.
verses.57:2: Do you then truly speak righteousness? Do you judge uprightly, sons of men?
verses.57:3: For indeed, in your heart you work acts of lawlessness on the earth; your hands weave together unrighteousness.
verses.57:4: Sinners were estranged from the womb; they went astray from the belly; they spoke falsehoods.
verses.57:5: They have fury according to the likeness of a serpent, like a deaf asp that stops up its ears,
verses.57:6: which will not listen to the voice of charmers or to a charm being worked by a wise one.
verses.57:7: God crushed their teeth in their mouth; the Lord shattered the molars of the lions.
verses.57:8: They will be brought to nothing like water flowing away; He will bend His bow until they grow weak.
verses.57:9: Like wax that has melted they will be taken away; fire fell, and they did not see the sun.
verses.57:10: Before your thorns understand the bramble, as if alive, as if in wrath, He will swallow you up.
verses.57:11: A righteous one will rejoice when he sees vengeance on the ungodly; he will wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.
verses.57:12: And a person will say, "Is there then fruit for the righteous one? Indeed, God is judging them on the earth."
verses.58:1: For the end; do not destroy; for David, for a pillar inscription, when Saul sent and watched his house to put him to death.
verses.58:2: Deliver me from my enemies, God, and redeem me from those who rise up against me.
verses.58:3: Rescue me from those who work lawlessness, and save me from men of bloodshed.
verses.58:4: For look, they hunted my soul; strong ones attacked me—it is neither my lawlessness nor my sin, Lord.
verses.58:5: Without lawlessness I ran and kept a straight course; awake to meet me and see,
verses.58:6: and You, Lord God of powers, God of Israel, attend to visiting all the nations; do not have pity on any of those who work lawlessness. Interlude.
verses.58:7: They will return toward evening and go hungry like a dog, and they will go around a city.
verses.58:8: Look, they will speak out with their mouth, and a sword is on their lips; for, "Who has heard?"
verses.58:9: And You, Lord, will laugh at them; You will bring all the nations to nothing.
verses.58:10: I will keep my strength for You, for You are God, my protector.
verses.58:11: My God—His mercy will go before me; my God will show me among my enemies.
verses.58:12: Do not kill them, so that they may never forget Your law; scatter them by Your power and bring them down, my defender, Lord.
verses.58:13: For the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips, let them also be caught in their pride; and because of cursing and falsehood there will be proclaimed
verses.58:14: destructions, in wrath of destruction, and they will certainly not exist; and they will know that the God of Jacob rules over the ends of the earth. Interlude.
verses.58:15: They will return toward evening and go hungry like a dog, and they will go around a city;
verses.58:16: They will be scattered to eat, and if they are satisfied, they will also grumble.
verses.58:17: But I will sing of Your power, and in the morning I will exult in Your mercy, for You have become my protector and a refuge in a day of affliction.
verses.58:18: My helper, to You I will make melody, my God, for You are my protector, my God, my mercy.
verses.59:1: For the end: for those who will be changed, still for a pillar inscription for David, for instruction,
verses.59:2: when he set fire to Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria of Sobal, and Joab returned and struck the Valley of Salt, twelve thousand.
verses.59:3: God, You rejected us and tore us down; You were angry and had compassion on us.
verses.59:4: You shook the earth and threw it into turmoil; heal its fractures, for they have been shaken.
verses.59:5: You showed Your people hard things; You made us drink wine of stupor.
verses.59:6: You gave a signal to those who fear You, to flee from before the bow. Interlude.
verses.59:7: So that Your beloved ones may be delivered, save with Your right hand and hear me.
verses.59:8: God spoke in His holy place: "I will exult and divide Shechem, and I will measure out the Valley of Tents.
verses.59:9: Mine is Gilead, and Mine is Manasseh, and Ephraim is the strength of My head; Judah is My king;
verses.59:10: Moab is the basin of My hope; over Idumea I will stretch out My sandal; to Me foreigners have been subjected."
verses.59:11: Who will lead me into a fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Idumea?
verses.59:12: Is it not You, God, who rejected us? And will You not go out, God, with our armies?
verses.59:13: Give us help from affliction, and futile is the salvation of man.
verses.59:14: But in God we will act with power, and He Himself will bring to nothing those who afflict us.
verses.60:1: For the end, with hymns; for David.
verses.60:2: Hear my supplication; attend to my prayer.
verses.60:3: From the ends of the earth I cried out to You when my heart grew despondent. On a rock You lifted me up; You guided me,
verses.60:4: because You became my hope, a tower of strength from before an enemy.
verses.60:5: I will sojourn in Your tent forever. Interlude. I will be sheltered in the shelter of Your wings.
verses.60:6: For You, God, heard my prayers; You gave an inheritance to those who fear Your name.
verses.60:7: You will add days to the days of the king; his years will be until the day of generation and generation.
verses.60:8: He will abide forever before God; who among them will seek out His mercy and truth?
verses.60:9: Thus I will sing praise to Your name forever and ever, so that I may pay my vows day after day.
verses.61:1: For the end, for Jeduthun; a psalm for David.
verses.61:2: Will not my soul be subject to God? For from Him is my salvation.
verses.61:3: For indeed He is my God and my Savior, my protector; I will certainly not be shaken any further.
verses.61:4: How long will you attack a man? All of you commit murder, as against a leaning wall and a pushed-over fence.
verses.61:5: Yet they planned to thrust away my honor; they ran in thirst; with their mouth they were blessing, and in their heart they were cursing. Interlude.
verses.61:6: Yet be subject to God, my soul, for from Him is my endurance.
verses.61:7: For He is my God and my Savior, my protector; I will certainly not move away.
verses.61:8: In God are my salvation and my glory; He is the God of my help, and my hope is in God.
verses.61:9: Hope in Him, all the congregation of the people; pour out your hearts before Him; God is our helper. Interlude.
verses.61:10: Yet futile are the sons of men; false are the sons of men in scales to do injustice; they themselves are of futility altogether.
verses.61:11: Do not hope in injustice, and do not long for plunder; if wealth flows, do not attach your heart to it.
verses.61:12: Once God spoke; these two things I heard, that power belongs to God,
verses.61:13: and to You, Lord, belongs mercy; for You will repay each one according to his works.
verses.62:1: A psalm for David, when he was in the wilderness of Idumea.
verses.62:2: God, my God, to You I rise early; my soul has thirsted for You, how many times my flesh for You, in a desolate and untrodden and waterless land,
verses.62:3: so in the sanctuary I have appeared to You, to see Your power and Your glory.
verses.62:4: For Your mercy is better than lives; my lips will praise You.
verses.62:5: So I will bless You in my life; in Your name I will lift up my hands.
verses.62:6: As with tallow and fatness may my soul be filled, and lips of exultation will praise Your name.
verses.62:7: If I remembered You on my bed, in my early morning I meditated on You,
verses.62:8: for You have become my helper, and in the shelter of Your wings I will exult.
verses.62:9: My soul has clung behind You; Your right hand has taken hold of me.
verses.62:10: But they sought my soul in vain; they will enter into the lowest parts of the earth,
verses.62:11: they will be delivered into the hands of a sword; they will be portions for foxes.
verses.62:12: But the king will rejoice in God; everyone who swears by Him will be praised, because the mouth of those who speak unrighteous things has been stopped.
verses.63:1: For the end; a psalm for David.
verses.63:2: Hear, God, my prayer when I plead to You; from fear of an enemy rescue my soul.
verses.63:3: You have sheltered me from a conspiracy of evildoers, from a multitude of those who work unrighteousness,
verses.63:4: who sharpened their tongues like a sword, bent a bow, a bitter thing,
verses.63:5: to shoot down a blameless one in secret places; suddenly they will shoot him down and will not fear.
verses.63:6: They strengthened for themselves an evil word; they talked of hiding snares; they said, "Who will see them?"
verses.63:7: They searched out lawlessness; they failed while searching out with a search; a person will draw near, and a deep heart,
verses.63:8: and God will be exalted. Their blows became an arrow of infants,
verses.63:9: and their tongues despised him. All who looked at them were troubled,
verses.63:10: and every person feared; and they declared the works of God, and understood His deeds.
verses.63:11: A righteous person will rejoice in the Lord and will hope in Him; and all the upright in heart will be praised.
verses.64:1: For the end; a psalm for David, a song.
verses.64:2: To You a hymn is fitting, God, in Zion, and to You a vow will be paid.
verses.64:3: Hear my prayer; to You all flesh will come.
verses.64:4: Words of the lawless overpowered us, and You will pardon our impieties.
verses.64:5: Blessed is the one whom You have chosen and taken to Yourself; he will dwell in Your courts. We will be filled with the good things of Your house; holy is Your temple,
verses.64:6: marvelous in righteousness. Answer us, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth,
verses.64:7: preparing mountains in Your strength, girded with might,
verses.64:8: the One who troubles the water of the sea, the sounds of its waves. The nations will be troubled,
verses.64:9: and those who inhabit the ends will fear at Your signs; You will delight the outgoings of morning and evening.
verses.64:10: You visited the earth and drenched it; You multiplied to enrich it; the river of God was filled with waters; You prepared their food, for thus is Your preparation.
verses.64:11: Drench its furrows, multiply its crops; in its drops it will rejoice as it sprouts.
verses.64:12: You will bless the crown of the year of Your goodness, and Your plains will be filled with fatness;
verses.64:13: the mountains of the wilderness will grow fat, and the hills will gird themselves with exultation.
verses.64:14: The rams of the sheep have clothed themselves, and the valleys will multiply grain; they will shout, for indeed they will sing hymns.
verses.65:1: For the end; a song of a psalm of resurrection. Raise a joyful shout to God, all the earth;
verses.65:2: sing praise now to His name; give glory to His praise.
verses.65:3: Say to God, "How fearsome are Your works! In the abundance of Your power Your enemies will lie to You.
verses.65:4: Let all the earth worship You and sing praise to You; let them sing praise to Your name." Interlude.
verses.65:5: Come, children, and see the works of God; He is fearsome in counsels beyond the sons of men,
verses.65:6: who turns the sea into dry land; through a river they will pass on foot. There we will be glad in Him,
verses.65:7: who rules in the might of His eternity. His eyes look upon the nations; let those who rebel not be exalted in themselves. Interlude.
verses.65:8: Bless our God, nations, and make the voice of His praise heard,
verses.65:9: who placed my soul into life, and did not give my feet to shaking.
verses.65:10: For You tested us, God, and You refined us with fire as silver is refined with fire.
verses.65:11: You brought us into the snare; You placed afflictions before us;
verses.65:12: You made men ride upon our heads; we passed through fire and water, and You brought us out into refreshment.
verses.65:13: I will enter into Your house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,
verses.65:14: which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke in my affliction.
verses.65:15: Whole burnt offerings full of marrow I will offer up to You with incense and rams; I will offer to You oxen with male goats. Interlude.
verses.65:16: Come, listen, and I will recount, all you who fear the Lord, all that He has done for my soul.
verses.65:17: To Him I cried out with my mouth, and I exalted Him under my tongue.
verses.65:18: If I looked upon unrighteousness in the heart, let the Lord not hear.
verses.65:19: Therefore God heard me; He paid attention to the voice of my prayer.
verses.65:20: Blessed is God, who did not remove my prayer and His mercy from me.
verses.66:1: For the end, with hymns; a psalm for David.
verses.66:2: May God have compassion on us and bless us; may He cause His face to shine upon us—Interlude—
verses.66:3: so that Your way may be known on the earth, and Your salvation among all nations.
verses.66:4: Let peoples give thanks, God; let all peoples give thanks.
verses.66:5: Let nations be glad and exult, for You will judge peoples in uprightness, and You will guide nations on the earth. Interlude.
verses.66:6: Let peoples give thanks to You, God; let all peoples give thanks to You.
verses.66:7: The earth has given its fruit; may God, our God, bless us;
verses.66:8: may God bless us, and let all the ends of the earth fear Him.
verses.67:1: For the end; for David, a psalm of a song.
verses.67:2: Let God rise up, and let His enemies be scattered, and let those who hate Him flee from His presence.
verses.67:3: As smoke vanishes, let them vanish; as wax melts from the presence of fire, so may the sinners perish from the presence of God.
verses.67:4: And let the righteous be glad. Interlude. Let them exult before God; let them delight in gladness.
verses.67:5: Sing to God, sing praise to His name; make a road for the One who rides upon the west—the Lord is His name—and exult before Him.
verses.67:6: They will be troubled from the presence of Him, the Father of the orphans and Judge of the widows; God is in His holy place.
verses.67:7: God causes the solitary to dwell in a house, bringing out those who are fettered with valor, likewise those who rebel, those who dwell in tombs.
verses.67:8: God, when You went out before Your people, when You passed through the wilderness—Interlude—
verses.67:9: the earth was shaken, for indeed the heavens dripped from the presence of the God of Sinai, from the presence of the God of Israel.
verses.67:10: You will set apart a voluntary rain, God, for Your inheritance; and it grew weak, but You restored it.
verses.67:11: Your living creatures dwell in it; You prepared in Your goodness for the poor.
verses.67:12: God the Lord will give a word to those who proclaim good news with great power;
verses.67:13: the king of the powers of the beloved, of the beloved, and for the beauty of the house to divide spoils.
verses.67:14: If you sleep in the midst of the allotments, wings of a dove overlaid with silver, and her back in the greenish-yellow of gold. Interlude.
verses.67:15: When the Heavenly One separates kings upon it, they will be covered with snow in Zalmon.
verses.67:16: A mountain of God is a fat mountain, a curdled mountain, a fat mountain.
verses.67:17: Why do you suppose, curdled mountains? The mountain in which God was well pleased to dwell—for indeed the Lord will take up His dwelling to the end.
verses.67:18: The chariot of God is ten-thousandfold, thousands of those who prosper; the Lord is among them in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.67:19: Having gone up to the height, You captured captivity; You received gifts in man, for even those who disobey, to take up dwelling.
verses.67:20: The Lord God is blessed, blessed is the Lord day by day, and the God of our salvations will prosper our way. Interlude.
verses.67:21: Our God is the God of saving, and to the Lord belong the ways out of death.
verses.67:22: Yet God will crush the heads of His enemies, the crown of hair of those who walk on in his trespasses.
verses.67:23: The Lord said, "From Bashan I will turn back, I will turn back in the depths of the sea,
verses.67:24: so that your foot may be dipped in blood, the tongue of your dogs from enemies, from it."
verses.67:25: Your processions were seen, God, the processions of my God, the King, who is in the holy place.
verses.67:26: Rulers went ahead, next to those making melody, in the midst of young women playing tambourines.
verses.67:27: In assemblies bless God, the Lord from the springs of Israel.
verses.67:28: There is Benjamin, the younger, in ecstasy; rulers of Judah, their leaders; rulers of Zebulun, rulers of Naphtali.
verses.67:29: Command, God, Your power; strengthen, God, this which You prepared for us.
verses.67:30: From Your temple at Jerusalem, to You kings will bring gifts.
verses.67:31: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reed; the assembly of the bulls is among the heifers of the peoples, so that those who have been tested with silver may not be shut out; scatter nations that desire wars.
verses.67:32: Envoys will come from Egypt; Ethiopia will hasten her hand to God.
verses.67:33: Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God, sing praise to the Lord. Interlude.
verses.67:34: Sing praise to God, who rides upon the heaven of heaven toward the east. Look, He will give with His voice a voice of power.
verses.67:35: Give glory to God; over Israel is His majesty, and His power is in the clouds.
verses.67:36: Wondrous is God in His devout ones; the God of Israel, He Himself will give power and strength to His people. And blessed is God.
verses.68:1: For the end, concerning those who will be changed; for David.
verses.68:2: Save me, God, for waters have come in up to my soul.
verses.68:3: I sank fast into the mire of the deep, and there is no foothold; I came into the depths of the sea, and a storm submerged me.
verses.68:4: I grew weary crying out, my throat became hoarse, my eyes failed from drawing near to my God.
verses.68:5: Those who hate me without cause have multiplied beyond the hairs of my head; my enemies who pursue me unjustly have become strong; the things I did not seize, then I was paying back.
verses.68:6: God, You know my foolishness, and my offenses have not been hidden from You.
verses.68:7: May those who wait for You not be put to shame on my account, Lord of powers; may those who seek You not be disgraced on my account, God of Israel.
verses.68:8: Because for Your sake I have borne reproach, disgrace has covered my face;
verses.68:9: I have become estranged from my brothers, and a stranger to the sons of my mother;
verses.68:10: because zeal for Your house will consume me, and the reproaches of those who reproach You fell on me.
verses.68:11: And I bowed down my soul in fasting, and it became a reproach to me;
verses.68:12: and I made sackcloth my garment, and I became a byword to them.
verses.68:13: Those who sit in the gate were chattering against me, and those who drink wine were singing about me.
verses.68:14: But as for me, in my prayer to You, Lord, it is a time of favor, God; in the abundance of Your mercy listen, in the truth of Your salvation.
verses.68:15: Save me from the clay, so that I may not sink fast; may I be delivered from those who hate me and from the depth of the waters.
verses.68:16: Do not let a storm of water submerge me, nor let the deep swallow me up, nor let a well shut its mouth over me.
verses.68:17: Hear me, Lord, for Your mercy is good; according to the abundance of Your compassions, look upon me.
verses.68:18: Because I am afflicted, listen to me quickly.
verses.68:19: Attend to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies, deliver me.
verses.68:20: For You know my reproach and my shame and my disgrace; before You are all those who afflict me.
verses.68:21: My soul expected reproach and misery; and I waited for one who would sympathize, and there was none, and for one who would comfort, and I found none.
verses.68:22: And for my food they gave gall, and for my thirst they gave me sour wine to drink.
verses.68:23: Let their table before them become a snare, and a retribution, and a stumbling block;
verses.68:24: let their eyes be darkened so that they do not see, and bow down their back continually;
verses.68:25: pour out Your wrath upon them, and may the fury of Your wrath overtake them.
verses.68:26: Let their homestead become desolate, and in their tents let there be no one who dwells;
verses.68:27: because they pursued the one whom You struck, and they added to the pain of my wounds.
verses.68:28: Add lawlessness upon their lawlessness, and let them not enter into Your righteousness;
verses.68:29: let them be blotted out from the book of the living, and let them not be written with the righteous.
verses.68:30: I am poor and in pain, and the salvation of Your face upheld me.
verses.68:31: I will praise the name of God with a song, I will magnify Him with praise,
verses.68:32: and it will please God more than a young calf bringing forth horns and hooves.
verses.68:33: Let the poor see and be glad; seek God, and you will live.
verses.68:34: For the Lord has heard the needy, and He has not despised His prisoners.
verses.68:35: Let the heavens and the earth praise Him, the sea and all things that move in them.
verses.68:36: For God will save Zion, and the cities of Judea will be built, and they will dwell there and inherit it;
verses.68:37: and the seed of His servants will possess it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
verses.69:1: For the end; for David, for a remembrance, that the Lord may save me.
verses.69:3: May those who seek my soul be ashamed and disgraced; may those who wish evil for me be turned back and put to shame;
verses.69:4: may those who say to me, "Aha, aha!" be turned back immediately, ashamed.
verses.69:5: Let all those who seek You exult and be glad in You, and let those who love Your salvation say continually, "Let God be magnified."
verses.69:6: But I am poor and needy; God, help me; You are my helper and my deliverer; Lord, do not delay.
verses.70:1: For David, of the sons of Jonadab and of those first taken captive. God, in You I have hoped; may I never be put to shame.
verses.70:2: In Your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline Your ear to me and save me.
verses.70:3: Become for me a defending God, a fortified place to save me, for You are my stronghold and my refuge.
verses.70:4: God, deliver me from the hand of a sinner, from the hand of a lawbreaker and wrongdoer;
verses.70:5: for You are my expectation, Lord; the Lord is my hope from my youth.
verses.70:6: Upon You I have leaned from the womb; from my mother's womb You are my protector; in You is my song of praise continually.
verses.70:7: I have become like a portent to many, and You are a strong helper.
verses.70:8: Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may sing of Your glory, all day long of Your majesty.
verses.70:9: Do not cast me away at the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
verses.70:10: For my enemies spoke concerning me, and those who watch for my soul took counsel together,
verses.70:11: saying, "God has forsaken him; pursue and overtake him, for there is no one who delivers."
verses.70:12: God, do not keep far from me.
verses.70:13: Let those who slander my soul be ashamed and fail; let those who seek evil for me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
verses.70:14: But I will hope continually, and I will add to all Your praise.
verses.70:15: My mouth will proclaim Your righteousness, all day long Your salvation, for I have not known business affairs.
verses.70:16: I will enter in the might of the Lord; Lord, I will remember Your righteousness, Yours alone.
verses.70:17: You have taught me, God, from my youth, and up to now I will declare Your wonders,
verses.70:18: and even to old age and advanced years; God, do not forsake me until I declare Your arm to every generation that is coming, Your might
verses.70:19: and Your righteousness, God, up to the highest places, the great things that You have done. God, who is like You?
verses.70:20: Because You showed me many afflictions and evils, and turning back You made me alive, and from the abysses of the earth You brought me up again,
verses.70:21: multiplying Your righteousness. And turning back You comforted me, and from the abysses You brought me up again.
verses.70:22: For I will also praise Your truth to You with a musical instrument; I will sing to You, God, with a lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.70:23: My lips will exult when I sing to You, and my soul, which You have redeemed.
verses.70:24: And moreover my tongue also will meditate on Your righteousness all day long, when those who seek evil for me are ashamed and disgraced.
verses.71:1: For Solomon. God, give Your judgment to the king, and Your righteousness to the son of the king,
verses.71:2: to judge Your people in righteousness and Your poor in justice.
verses.71:3: Let the mountains take up peace for Your people, and the hills.
verses.71:4: In righteousness he will judge the poor of the people; and You will save the sons of the needy, and he will humble a false accuser.
verses.71:5: And he will remain alongside the sun, and before the moon through generations of generations.
verses.71:6: And he will come down like rain upon a fleece, and like drops dripping upon the earth.
verses.71:7: Righteousness will spring up in his days, and an abundance of peace until the moon is taken away.
verses.71:8: And he will have dominion from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the inhabited world.
verses.71:9: Before him Ethiopians will fall down, and his enemies will lick dust.
verses.71:10: Kings of Tarshish and the islands will offer gifts; kings of the Arabs and Saba will present gifts.
verses.71:11: And all the kings will bow down to him; all the nations will serve him.
verses.71:12: For he rescued a poor man from the hand of a mighty one, and a needy man for whom there was no helper.
verses.71:13: He will spare the poor and the needy, and he will save the souls of the needy.
verses.71:14: From usury and from injustice he will redeem their souls, and their name will be precious before him.
verses.71:15: And he will live, and there will be given to him from the gold of Arabia; and they will pray for him continually; all day long they will bless him.
verses.71:16: There will be a support in the earth upon the tops of the mountains; his fruit will be lifted high above Lebanon, and they will blossom from a city like grass of the earth.
verses.71:17: May his name be blessed forever; before the sun his name will endure; and in him all the tribes of the earth will be blessed; all the nations will call him blessed.
verses.71:18: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who alone does wondrous things,
verses.71:19: and blessed is the name of His glory forever, and forever and ever; and all the earth will be filled with His glory. May it be so, may it be so.
verses.71:20: The hymns of David, the son of Jesse, have come to an end.
verses.72:1: A psalm for Asaph. How good God is to Israel, to those who are upright in heart!
verses.72:2: But as for me, my feet were nearly shaken; my steps were almost poured out.
verses.72:3: For I was envious of the lawless, observing the peace of sinners.
verses.72:4: For there is no reluctance in their death, and firmness is in their scourge.
verses.72:5: They are not in the troubles of men, and with men they will not be scourged.
verses.72:6: Therefore arrogance has taken hold of them; they clothed themselves with their injustice and ungodliness.
verses.72:7: Their injustice will come out as from fat; they passed through into the disposition of the heart.
verses.72:8: They thought and spoke in wickedness; they spoke injustice toward the height.
verses.72:9: They set their mouth toward heaven, and their tongue passed across the earth.
verses.72:10: Therefore my people will turn back here, and full days will be found for them.
verses.72:11: And they said, "How has God known? And is there knowledge in the Most High?"
verses.72:12: Look, sinners—and they prosper; forever they have taken possession of wealth.
verses.72:13: And I said, "Surely in vain I have justified my heart, and washed my hands among the innocent,
verses.72:14: and I have been scourged all day long, and my reproof is for the mornings."
verses.72:15: If I said, "I will recount it this way," look, I have broken faith with the generation of Your sons.
verses.72:16: And I undertook to know; this was trouble before me,
verses.72:17: until I entered into the sanctuary of God and understood the end.
verses.72:18: Nevertheless, because of the deceits You appointed it for them.
verses.72:19: How have they come to desolation? Suddenly they failed; they perished because of their lawlessness.
verses.72:20: Like a dream of one waking up, Lord, in Your city You will despise their image.
verses.72:21: For my heart was gladdened, and my kidneys were changed;
verses.72:22: and I was despised and did not know; I became beastlike before You.
verses.72:23: Yet I am continually with You; You took hold of my right hand;
verses.72:24: in Your counsel You guided me, and with glory You received me.
verses.72:25: For what do I have in heaven? And from You, what have I desired upon the earth?
verses.72:26: My heart and my flesh have failed; God of my heart, and my portion is God forever.
verses.72:27: For look, those who distance themselves from You will perish; You have destroyed everyone who commits prostitution away from You.
verses.72:28: But for me, clinging to the Lord is good, to place my hope in the Lord, so as to declare all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
verses.73:1: Of understanding, for Asaph. Why have You rejected us, God, to the end? Has Your wrath grown angry against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.73:2: Remember Your congregation, which You acquired from the beginning; You redeemed the rod of Your inheritance, this Mount Zion in which You dwelt.
verses.73:3: Lift up Your hands against their acts of arrogance to the end—all that the enemy has done wickedly in Your holy places.
verses.73:4: And those who hate You boasted in the midst of Your feast,
verses.73:5: as at the entrance above; as in a thicket of trees, with axes they cut down
verses.73:6: its doors; together, with hatchet and chisel they smashed it down.
verses.73:7: They burned Your sanctuary with fire; to the ground they profaned the dwelling place of Your name.
verses.73:8: They said in their heart, their kin together, "Come, and let us put an end to the feasts of the Lord from the earth."
verses.73:9: We have not seen our signs; there is no longer a prophet, and He will know us no longer.
verses.73:10: How long, God, will the enemy taunt? Will the adversary provoke Your name to the end?
verses.73:11: Why do You turn away Your hand, and Your right hand from the midst of Your bosom, to the end?
verses.73:12: Yet our King before the age worked salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.73:13: You strengthened the sea in Your power; You crushed the heads of the dragons upon the water.
verses.73:14: You gave him as food to the Ethiopian peoples.
verses.73:15: You split open springs and torrents.
verses.73:16: Yours is the day, and Yours is the night; You prepared sun and moon.
verses.73:17: You made all the boundaries of the earth; summer and spring You made.
verses.73:18: Remember this creation of Yours. An enemy has taunted the Lord, and a foolish people has provoked His name.
verses.73:19: Do not hand over to the wild beasts a soul that gives thanks to You; do not forget the souls of Your needy to the end.
verses.73:20: Look upon Your covenant, for the darkened ones of the earth have been filled with houses of lawlessness.
verses.73:21: Do not let one who is humbled and put to shame be turned away; the poor and the needy will praise Your name.
verses.73:22: Rise up, God, judge Your case; remember the taunts against You, those from a fool all day long.
verses.73:23: Do not forget the voice of Your suppliants; may the arrogance of those who hate You ascend continually to You.
verses.74:1: For the end; do not destroy; a psalm of a song for Asaph.
verses.74:2: We will give thanks to You, God; we will give thanks and call upon Your name; I will recount all Your wonders,
verses.74:3: when I take an appointed time; I will judge with uprightness.
verses.74:4: The earth melted, and all who inhabit it; I made its pillars firm. Interlude.
verses.74:5: I said to the lawless not to act lawlessly, and to those who sin, "Do not lift up a horn;
verses.74:6: do not raise your horn on high; do not speak unrighteousness against God."
verses.74:7: For neither from the east nor from the west nor from deserts,
verses.74:8: for God is judge; He humbles this one and lifts up that one.
verses.74:9: For a cup is in the hand of the Lord, of unmixed wine, full of mixture, and He poured from this into that; yet its dregs were not emptied out, and all the sinners of the earth will drink.
verses.74:10: But I will exult forever; I will sing psalms to the God of Jacob;
verses.74:11: and I will break all the horns of the sinners, and the horns of the righteous one will be lifted up.
verses.75:1: For the end, with hymns; a psalm for Asaph, a song, concerning the Assyrian.
verses.75:2: God is known in Judea; in Israel His name is great.
verses.75:3: And His place was in peace, and His dwelling place in Zion;
verses.75:4: there He shattered the powers of the bows, shield and sword and war; there He will break the horns. Interlude.
verses.75:5: You shine wondrously from eternal mountains.
verses.75:6: All the senseless in heart were troubled; they slept their sleep, and all the men of wealth found nothing in their hands.
verses.75:7: At Your rebuke, God of Jacob, those who mounted the horses slumbered.
verses.75:8: You are fearsome, and who will withstand You because of Your wrath?
verses.75:9: From heaven You hurled judgment; the earth feared and grew still,
verses.75:10: when God arose for judgment, to save all the meek in heart. Interlude.
verses.75:11: For the thought of man will give thanks to You, and a remnant of thought will keep a festival to You.
verses.75:12: Make vows and pay them to the Lord our God; all those around Him will bring gifts
verses.75:13: to Him who is fearsome and takes away the spirits of rulers, fearsome among the kings of the earth.
verses.76:1: For the end, on behalf of Jeduthun; a psalm for Asaph.
verses.76:2: With my voice I cried out to the Lord, and my voice was to God, and He paid attention to me.
verses.76:3: In the day of my distress I sought out God, with my hands by night before Him, and I was not deceived; my soul refused to be consoled.
verses.76:4: I remembered God and was gladdened; I mused, and my spirit grew faint. Interlude.
verses.76:5: My enemies seized the watches beforehand; I was troubled and did not speak.
verses.76:6: I considered ancient days, and eternal years
verses.76:7: I remembered, and I meditated; at night I was musing with my heart, and my spirit was searching.
verses.76:8: Will the Lord reject forever, and will He no longer continue to be well pleased?
verses.76:9: Or will He cut off mercy to the end, from generation to generation?
verses.76:10: Or will God forget to have compassion, or will He hold back His compassions in His wrath? Interlude.
verses.76:11: And I said, "Now I have begun; this is the change of the right hand of the Most High."
verses.76:12: I remembered the works of the Lord; for I will remember Your wonders from the beginning,
verses.76:13: and I will meditate on all Your works, and I will muse on Your deeds.
verses.76:14: God, Your way is in the holy place; what god is great like our God?
verses.76:15: You are our God who does wonders; You made known Your power among Your peoples;
verses.76:16: You redeemed Your people with Your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Interlude.
verses.76:17: The waters saw You, God; the waters saw You and feared, and the depths were troubled;
verses.76:18: a multitude of the sound of water; the clouds gave a voice, for indeed Your arrows pass through;
verses.76:19: the voice of Your thunder was in the wheel; the earth was shaken and trembled.
verses.76:20: Your way is in the sea, and Your paths are in many waters, and Your footprints will not be known.
verses.76:21: You guided Your people like sheep by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.77:1: Of understanding, for Asaph. Pay attention, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.77:2: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter riddles from the beginning,
verses.77:3: all the things that we heard and knew, and that our fathers recounted to us.
verses.77:4: They were not hidden from their children to another generation, declaring the praises of the Lord and His mighty acts, and His wonders that He did.
verses.77:5: And He raised up a testimony in Jacob, and set a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to make known to their sons,
verses.77:6: so that another generation might know, sons who will be born, and they will rise up and declare them to their sons;
verses.77:7: so that they might set their hope on God, and not forget the works of God, and will seek out His commandments;
verses.77:8: so that they might not become like their fathers, a crooked and provoking generation, a generation that did not keep straight in its heart, and whose spirit was not proven faithful with God.
verses.77:9: The sons of Ephraim, drawing and shooting a bow, turned back on the day of battle.
verses.77:10: They did not keep the covenant of God, and they were not willing to walk in His law.
verses.77:11: And they forgot His good deeds and His wonders that He showed them,
verses.77:12: wonders that He did before their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Tanis.
verses.77:13: He split open the sea and brought them through; He made the waters stand like a waterskin.
verses.77:14: And He guided them with a cloud by day, and all the night with the light of fire.
verses.77:15: He split open a rock in the wilderness, and gave them drink as in a great abyss.
verses.77:16: And He brought out water from a rock, and brought down waters like rivers.
verses.77:17: And they continued still more to sin against Him; they provoked the Most High in a waterless place,
verses.77:18: and they tested God in their hearts, by asking for foods for their souls.
verses.77:19: And they spoke against God and said, "Will God be able to prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.77:20: Since He struck a rock, and waters flowed, and torrents overflowed, will He also be able to give bread? Or to prepare a table for His people?"
verses.77:21: Therefore the Lord heard and delayed, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose up against Israel,
verses.77:22: because they did not believe in God, nor did they hope in His salvation.
verses.77:23: And He commanded the clouds above, and opened the doors of heaven.
verses.77:24: And He rained manna for them to eat, and He gave them bread of heaven.
verses.77:25: Man ate bread of angels; He sent them provisions to the full.
verses.77:26: And He raised up a south wind from heaven, and by His might He brought in a southwest wind,
verses.77:27: and He rained flesh upon them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the seas.
verses.77:28: And they fell into the middle of their camp, all around their tents.
verses.77:29: And they ate and were exceedingly filled, and He brought them their desire.
verses.77:30: They were not deprived of their desire; while the food
verses.77:31: of theirs was still in their mouth, the wrath of God rose up against them and killed among the majority of them, and fettered the chosen ones of Israel.
verses.77:32: In all these things they sinned still more, and they did not believe in
verses.77:33: His wonders; and their days failed in futility, and their years with haste.
verses.77:34: Whenever He was killing them, they sought Him, and turned back and
verses.77:35: came early to God; and they remembered that God is their helper, and God the Most High is their redeemer.
verses.77:36: And they loved Him with their mouth, and with their tongue
verses.77:37: they lied to Him; and their heart was not upright with Him, nor were they proven faithful in His covenant.
verses.77:38: But He is compassionate and will pardon their sins, and will not destroy; and many times He will turn away His anger, and He will not kindle all His wrath.
verses.77:39: And He remembered that they are flesh, a wind going on and not returning.
verses.77:40: How many times did they provoke Him in the wilderness, anger
verses.77:41: Him in a waterless land? And they turned back and tested God, and exasperated the Holy One of Israel.
verses.77:42: They did not remember His hand, the day on which He redeemed them from the hand of an oppressor,
verses.77:43: how He set His signs in Egypt, and
verses.77:44: His portents in the plain of Tanis; and He turned their rivers into blood, and their rainwaters, so that they might not drink.
verses.77:45: He sent out against them the dog-fly, and it devoured them, and the frog, and it destroyed them.
verses.77:46: And He gave their fruit to the blight, and their labors to the locust.
verses.77:47: He killed their vine with hail, and their sycamore trees with
verses.77:48: the frost; and He gave up their livestock in hail, and their possessions to fire.
verses.77:49: He sent out against them the wrath of His anger, anger and wrath and affliction, a dispatch through
verses.77:50: evil angels. He made a path for His wrath; He did not spare their souls from death, and He confined their livestock to death.
verses.77:51: And He struck every firstborn in Egypt, the firstfruits of their labors in the tents of Ham.
verses.77:52: And He brought His people out like sheep, and led them like
verses.77:53: a flock in the wilderness; and He guided them in hope and they were not afraid, and the sea covered their enemies.
verses.77:54: And He brought them in to the mountain of His sanctuary, this mountain which
verses.77:55: His right hand acquired; and He drove out nations from before them, and He allotted them by a line of inheritance, and made a dwelling in their tents for the tribes of Israel.
verses.77:56: And they tested and provoked God the Most High, and they did not keep His testimonies.
verses.77:57: And they turned back and broke faith just as their fathers also did, and they were turned into a warped bow.
verses.77:58: And they angered Him on their hills, and with their carved images they provoked Him to jealousy.
verses.77:59: God heard, and disdained and despised Israel exceedingly.
verses.77:60: And He rejected the tent of Shiloh, His dwelling
verses.77:61: where He dwelt among men; and He gave over their strength into captivity, and His beauty into the hands of an enemy.
verses.77:62: And He confined His people to the sword, and He disdained His inheritance.
verses.77:63: Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins did not mourn.
verses.77:64: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows will not be wept for.
verses.77:65: And the Lord awoke like one sleeping, like a mighty man dazed
verses.77:66: from wine. And He struck their enemies in the rear; He gave them an eternal reproach.
verses.77:67: And He rejected the dwelling of Joseph, and He did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.77:68: and He chose the tribe of Judah; Mount Zion He loved.
verses.77:69: And He built His sanctuary like that of unicorns; on the earth He founded it forever.
verses.77:70: And He chose David His servant, and took him up from the
verses.77:71: flocks of sheep; from behind those bearing young He took him, to shepherd Jacob His servant and Israel His inheritance.
verses.77:72: And he shepherded them in the innocence of his heart, and with the understanding of his hands he guided them.
verses.78:1: A psalm for Asaph. God, nations came into Your inheritance; they defiled Your holy temple; they made Jerusalem into a fruit-watcher's hut.
verses.78:2: They set the corpses of Your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of Your devout ones for the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.78:3: They poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
verses.78:4: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, mockery and scoffing to those around us.
verses.78:5: How long, Lord, will You be angry to the end? Will Your zeal blaze like fire?
verses.78:6: Pour out Your wrath upon nations that have not known You, and upon kingdoms that have not called upon Your name.
verses.78:7: For they have devoured Jacob and made his place desolate.
verses.78:8: Do not remember our former lawless deeds; may Your compassions quickly come to meet us, for we have become exceedingly poor.
verses.78:9: Help us, God our Savior, for the sake of the glory of Your name; Lord, deliver us and pardon our sins for the sake of Your name,
verses.78:10: so that they may never say among the nations, "Where is their God?" And let the avenging of the blood of Your servants that was poured out be made known among the nations before our eyes.
verses.78:11: Let the groaning of those bound in fetters come before You; according to the greatness of Your arm, preserve the sons of those put to death.
verses.78:12: Repay our neighbors sevenfold into their lap, their reproach with which they reproached You, Lord.
verses.78:13: For we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, will give thanks to You forever; to generation and generation we will proclaim Your praise.
verses.79:1: For the end, concerning those who will be changed; a testimony for Asaph, a psalm concerning the Assyrian.
verses.79:2: You who shepherd Israel, pay attention, You who lead Joseph like sheep; You who sit upon the cherubim, appear.
verses.79:3: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, rouse Your might and come to save us.
verses.79:4: God, turn us back and make Your face shine, and we will be saved.
verses.79:5: Lord God of powers, how long are You angry at the prayer of Your servant?
verses.79:6: Will You feed us bread of tears and give us tears to drink by measure?
verses.79:7: You made us a contention to our neighbors, and our enemies mocked us.
verses.79:8: Lord God of powers, turn us back and make Your face shine, and we will be saved. Interlude.
verses.79:9: You transferred a vine out of Egypt; You drove out nations and planted it.
verses.79:10: You made a way before it, and planted its roots, and the land was filled.
verses.79:11: Its shadow covered mountains, and its climbing vines the cedars of God.
verses.79:12: It stretched out its branches as far as the sea, and its offshoots as far as the river.
verses.79:13: Why have You torn down its fence, so that all who pass along the road pluck it?
verses.79:14: A boar from the forest ravaged it, and a wild donkey grazed on it.
verses.79:15: God of powers, turn back now; look down from heaven and see, and visit this vine,
verses.79:16: and restore it, which Your right hand planted, and upon the son of man whom You strengthened for Yourself.
verses.79:17: It is burned with fire and dug up; at the rebuke of Your face they will perish.
verses.79:18: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, and upon the son of man whom You strengthened for Yourself,
verses.79:19: and we will never depart from You; You will give us life, and we will call upon Your name.
verses.79:20: Lord God of powers, turn us back and make Your face shine, and we will be saved.
verses.80:1: For the end, concerning the winepresses; a psalm for Asaph.
verses.80:2: Exult in God our helper; shout aloud to the God of Jacob.
verses.80:3: Take up a psalm and sound a tambourine, a pleasant harp with a lyre.
verses.80:4: Blow a trumpet at the new moon, on the notable day of our feast,
verses.80:5: for it is a statute for Israel and a judgment for the God of Jacob.
verses.80:6: He appointed it as a testimony in Joseph when he went out from the land of Egypt; he heard a language that he did not know.
verses.80:7: He removed his back from burdens; his hands slaved at the basket.
verses.80:8: "In affliction you called upon Me and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of a storm; I tested you at the water of Contention." Interlude.
verses.80:9: "Listen, My people, and I will speak to you; Israel, and I testify to you. If you listen to Me,
verses.80:10: there will not be a new god among you, nor will you worship a foreign god.
verses.80:11: For I am the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt; widen your mouth, and I will fill it.
verses.80:12: And My people did not listen to My voice, and Israel did not pay attention to Me.
verses.80:13: And I sent them away according to the practices of their hearts; they will walk in their practices.
verses.80:14: If the people Israel had listened to Me, if they had walked in My ways,
verses.80:15: in no time I would have humbled their enemies, and I would have laid My hand upon those who afflict them."
verses.80:16: The enemies of the Lord lied to Him, and their time will be forever.
verses.80:17: And He fed them from the fat of wheat, and with honey from a rock He satisfied them.
verses.81:1: A psalm for Asaph. God stood in the assembly of gods, and in the midst He judges gods.
verses.81:2: How long will you judge with injustice and show partiality to sinners? Interlude.
verses.81:3: Do justice for the orphan and the poor; justify the lowly and the needy.
verses.81:4: Rescue the needy and the poor; deliver them from the hand of a sinner.
verses.81:5: They did not know, nor did they understand; they walk about in darkness. All the foundations of the earth will be shaken.
verses.81:6: I said, "You are gods, and sons of the Most High, all of you."
verses.81:7: Yet indeed, like humans you die, and like one of the rulers you fall.
verses.81:8: Rise up, God, judge the earth; for You will inherit among all the nations.
verses.82:1: A song of a psalm for Asaph.
verses.82:2: God, who will be likened to You? Do not keep silent, nor remain calm, God.
verses.82:3: For look, Your enemies have roared, and those who hate You have lifted up their head.
verses.82:4: Against Your people they craftily devised a plan, and they took counsel against Your holy ones.
verses.82:5: They said, "Come, and let us utterly destroy them from being a nation, and the name of Israel will never be remembered again."
verses.82:6: For they took counsel together with one mind; against You they made a covenant:
verses.82:7: the tents of the Idumeans and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagarenes,
verses.82:8: Naibal and Ammon and Amalek, and foreigners with those who dwell in Tyre.
verses.82:9: For indeed Asshur also joined with them; they became a help to the sons of Lot. Interlude.
verses.82:10: Do to them as to Midian and to Sisera, like Jabin at the brook Kishon.
verses.82:11: They were utterly destroyed at Endor; they became like dung for the ground.
verses.82:12: Make their rulers like Oreb and Zeeb and Zebah and Zalmunna, all their rulers,
verses.82:13: who said, "Let us inherit for ourselves the altar of God."
verses.82:14: My God, make them like a wheel, like stubble in the face of the wind.
verses.82:15: Like fire that will blaze through a forest, as if a flame were to burn up mountains,
verses.82:16: so You will pursue them in Your tempest, and in Your wrath You will dismay them.
verses.82:17: Fill their faces with dishonor, and they will seek Your name, Lord.
verses.82:18: Let them be put to shame and dismayed forever and ever, and let them be disgraced and perish,
verses.82:19: and let them know that Your name is the Lord; You alone are Most High over all the earth.
verses.83:1: For the end, concerning the winepresses; a psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.83:2: How beloved are Your dwellings, Lord of powers!
verses.83:3: My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord; my heart and my flesh have exulted in the living God.
verses.83:4: For indeed a sparrow has found a house for itself, and a turtledove a nest for herself where she will place her young: Your altars, Lord of powers, my King and my God.
verses.83:5: Blessed are all who dwell in Your house; forever and ever they will praise You. Interlude.
verses.83:6: Blessed is the man whose help is from You, Lord; he arranged ascents in his heart,
verses.83:7: in the valley of weeping, to the place that he appointed. For indeed the Lawgiver will give blessings;
verses.83:8: they will go from power to power; the God of gods will be seen in Zion.
verses.83:9: Lord God of powers, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Interlude.
verses.83:10: Look, God, our defender, and gaze upon the face of Your anointed one.
verses.83:11: For one day in Your courts is better than thousands; I have chosen to be cast aside in the house of God rather than to dwell in the tents of sinners.
verses.83:12: For the Lord God loves mercy and truth; He will give grace and glory. The Lord will not withhold good things from those who walk in innocence.
verses.83:13: Lord of powers, blessed is the person who hopes in You.
verses.84:1: For the end; for the sons of Korah, a psalm.
verses.84:2: You were pleased with Your land, Lord; You turned back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.84:3: You forgave Your people their lawless deeds; You covered their sins. Interlude.
verses.84:4: You put an end to Your wrath; You turned back from the wrath of Your fury.
verses.84:5: Turn us back, God of our salvation, and turn Your fury away from us.
verses.84:6: Will You be angry with us forever? Or will You extend Your wrath from generation to generation?
verses.84:7: God, You will turn back and make us alive, and Your people will rejoice in You.
verses.84:8: Show us Your mercy, Lord, and may You give us Your salvation, Lord.
verses.84:9: I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me, for He will speak peace to His people and to His devout ones, and to those who turn their heart toward Him.
verses.84:10: Indeed, His salvation is near to those who fear Him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.84:11: Mercy and truth met; righteousness and peace kissed.
verses.84:12: Truth sprang up from the earth, and righteousness peered down from heaven.
verses.84:13: For indeed, the Lord will give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.
verses.84:14: Righteousness will proceed before Him and will set His steps on a way.
verses.85:1: A prayer for David. Incline Your ear, Lord, and hear me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.85:2: Guard my soul, for I am devout; save Your servant, my God, who hopes in You.
verses.85:3: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I will cry out to You all day long.
verses.85:4: Gladden the soul of Your servant, for to You, Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
verses.85:5: For You, Lord, are good and gentle and abounding in mercy to all who call on You.
verses.85:6: Give ear to my prayer, Lord, and pay attention to the voice of my supplication.
verses.85:7: In the day of my distress I cried out to You, for You heard me.
verses.85:8: There is no one like You among the gods, Lord, and there is nothing like Your works.
verses.85:9: All the nations that You made will come and bow down before You, Lord, and will glorify Your name;
verses.85:10: for You are great and do wondrous things; You alone are God, the great One.
verses.85:11: Guide me, Lord, in Your way, and I will walk in Your truth; let my heart rejoice to fear Your name.
verses.85:12: I will give You thanks, Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forever;
verses.85:13: for Your mercy is great toward me, and You rescued my soul from the lowest Hades.
verses.85:14: God, lawless men rose up against me, and an assembly of mighty men sought my soul; they did not set You before them.
verses.85:15: And You, Lord God, are compassionate and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in mercy and true.
verses.85:16: Look upon me and have mercy on me; give Your might to Your servant, and save the son of Your maidservant.
verses.85:17: Work a sign with me for good, and let those who hate me see and be put to shame, because You, Lord, helped me and comforted me.
verses.86:1: For the sons of Korah, a psalm of a song. His foundations are in the holy mountains;
verses.86:2: the Lord loves the gates of Zion above all the tents of Jacob.
verses.86:3: Glorious things were spoken about you, city of God. Interlude.
verses.86:4: "I will mention Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me; and look, foreigners and Tyre and the people of the Ethiopians—these were born there."
verses.86:5: "Mother Zion," a man will say, and "A man was born in her," and "He Himself, the Most High, founded her."
verses.86:6: The Lord will recount in a register of peoples and rulers, of these who have been born in her. Interlude.
verses.86:7: The dwelling in you is like that of all who rejoice.
verses.87:1: A song of a psalm for the sons of Korah. For the end, concerning Mahalath, to answer; of understanding, for Heman the Israelite.
verses.87:2: Lord, God of my salvation, by day I cried out and in the night before You.
verses.87:3: Let my prayer enter before You; incline Your ear to my supplication, Lord.
verses.87:4: For my soul has been filled with evils, and my life has drawn near to Hades.
verses.87:5: I was counted with those going down into a pit; I became like a helpless man,
verses.87:6: free among the dead, like wounded men thrown down, sleeping in a tomb, whom You remembered no longer, and they were thrust away from Your hand.
verses.87:7: They placed me in the lowest pit, in dark places and in the shadow of death.
verses.87:8: Your fury pressed heavily upon me, and You brought all Your billows upon me. Interlude.
verses.87:9: You put my acquaintances far from me; they made me an abomination to themselves. I was handed over and did not go out.
verses.87:10: My eyes grew weak from poverty, and I cried out to You, Lord, all day long; I spread out my hands.
verses.87:11: Will You perform wonders for the dead? Or will physicians raise them up, and will they praise You?
verses.87:12: Will anyone recount Your mercy in a tomb, and Your truth in destruction?
verses.87:13: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in a forgotten land?
verses.87:14: And I, Lord, cried out to You, and in the morning my prayer will come before You.
verses.87:15: Why, Lord, do You reject my prayer and turn Your face away from me?
verses.87:16: I am poor and in labors from my youth; yet having been exalted, I was humbled and utterly perplexed.
verses.87:17: Your wrath passed over me, and Your terrors troubled me.
verses.87:18: They surrounded me like water all day long; they hemmed me in together.
verses.87:19: You put a friend far from me, and my acquaintances because of misery.
verses.88:1: Of understanding, for Ethan the Israelite.
verses.88:2: I will sing of Your mercies, Lord, forever; to generation and generation I will declare Your truth with my mouth.
verses.88:3: For You said, "Forever mercy will be built up"; in the heavens Your truth will be prepared.
verses.88:4: "I have made a covenant with My chosen ones; I have sworn to David My servant:
verses.88:5: 'Forever I will prepare your seed, and I will build your throne to generation and generation.'" Interlude.
verses.88:6: The heavens will praise Your wonders, Lord, and Your truth in the assembly of holy ones.
verses.88:7: For who in the clouds will be made equal to the Lord? And who will be likened to the Lord among the sons of God?
verses.88:8: God is glorified in the council of holy ones, great and fearsome over all those around Him.
verses.88:9: Lord, God of powers, who is like You? You are mighty, Lord, and Your truth is around You.
verses.88:10: You rule over the might of the sea, and You calm the surging of its waves.
verses.88:11: You humbled a proud one like a wounded man, and with the arm of Your strength You scattered Your enemies.
verses.88:12: Yours are the heavens, and Yours is the earth; the world and its fullness You founded.
verses.88:13: The north and the seas You created; Tabor and Hermoniim will exult in Your name.
verses.88:14: Yours is the arm with might; let Your hand be strengthened, let Your right hand be exalted.
verses.88:15: Righteousness and judgment are the preparation of Your throne; mercy and truth will go before Your face.
verses.88:16: Blessed is the people that knows the joyful shout; Lord, in the light of Your face they will walk,
verses.88:17: and in Your name they will exult all day long, and in Your righteousness they will be exalted.
verses.88:18: For You are the boast of their strength, and in Your favor our horn will be exalted.
verses.88:19: For protection belongs to the Lord, and to the Holy One of Israel, our King.
verses.88:20: Then You spoke in a vision to Your sons, and said, "I have placed help upon a mighty one; I have exalted a chosen one from My people.
verses.88:21: I have found David My servant; with holy mercy I have anointed him.
verses.88:22: For My hand will assist him, and My arm will strengthen him.
verses.88:23: An enemy will not gain an advantage over him, and a son of lawlessness will not proceed to harm him.
verses.88:24: And I will cut down his enemies from before his face, and I will put to flight those who hate him.
verses.88:25: And My truth and My mercy will be with him, and in My name his horn will be exalted.
verses.88:26: And I will set his hand on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.88:27: He will call upon Me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the protector of my salvation.'
verses.88:28: And I will make him firstborn, high among the kings of the earth.
verses.88:29: Forever I will keep My mercy for him, and My covenant will be faithful to him.
verses.88:30: And I will establish his seed forever and ever, and his throne like the days of heaven.
verses.88:31: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
verses.88:32: if they profane My statutes and do not keep My commandments,
verses.88:33: I will visit their lawless deeds with a rod, and their sins with lashes.
verses.88:34: Yet I will certainly not disperse My mercy from him, nor will I act unjustly in My truth;
verses.88:35: nor will I profane My covenant, and the things that go out through My lips I will certainly not nullify.
verses.88:36: Once I have sworn by My holiness; I will certainly not lie to David:
verses.88:37: his seed will remain forever, and his throne like the sun before Me,
verses.88:38: and like the moon, established forever; and the witness in heaven is faithful." Interlude.
verses.88:39: But You rejected and despised; You put off Your anointed one.
verses.88:40: You overturned the covenant of Your servant; You profaned his sanctuary to the ground.
verses.88:41: You tore down all his walls; You made his strongholds cowardice.
verses.88:42: All who pass along the way plundered him; he became a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.88:43: You exalted the right hand of his enemies; You gladdened all his enemies.
verses.88:44: You turned back the help of his sword, and You did not support him in battle.
verses.88:45: You removed him from purification; You dashed his throne to the ground.
verses.88:46: You shortened the days of his throne; You poured shame over him. Interlude.
