verses.88:47: How long, Lord, will You turn away to the end? Will Your wrath burn like fire?
verses.88:48: Remember what my existence is; for did You create all the sons of men in vain?
verses.88:49: Who is the man who will live and not see death? Will he deliver his soul from the hand of Hades? Interlude.
verses.88:50: Where are Your ancient mercies, Lord, which You swore to David in Your truth?
verses.88:51: Remember, Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which You bore in my bosom, of many nations,
verses.88:52: with which Your enemies reproached, Lord, with which they reproached the recompense of Your anointed one.
verses.88:53: Blessed be the Lord forever. So be it, so be it.
verses.89:1: A prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, You have become a refuge for us in generation after generation.
verses.89:2: Before the mountains came into being and the earth and the inhabited world were formed, even from eternity to eternity, You are.
verses.89:3: Do not turn man back to humiliation, and did You say, "Return, sons of men"?
verses.89:4: For a thousand years in Your eyes are like yesterday, which passed by, and a watch in the night.
verses.89:5: Their things of no account will be years; in the morning may it pass away like green grass.
verses.89:6: In the morning may it blossom and pass away; in the evening may it fall off, grow hard, and dry up.
verses.89:7: For we have come to an end in Your wrath, and in Your fury we have been troubled.
verses.89:8: You have set our lawless deeds before You; our lifetime is in the illumination of Your face.
verses.89:9: For all our days have come to an end, and in Your wrath we have come to an end; our years devised, as it were, a spider's web.
verses.89:10: The days of our years, in years, are seventy years, and if in strength, eighty years, and the greater part of them is toil and pain; for gentleness has come upon us, and we will be disciplined.
verses.89:11: Who knows the power of Your wrath, and out of the fear of Your fury how to reckon?
verses.89:12: Make known Your right hand, and those who have been disciplined in heart with wisdom.
verses.89:13: Return, Lord; how long? And be comforted over Your servants.
verses.89:14: We were satisfied in the morning with Your mercy, and we exulted and were glad in all our days,
verses.89:15: in return for the days in which You humbled us, the years in which we saw evils.
verses.89:16: And look upon Your servants and Your works, and guide their sons.
verses.89:17: And let the splendor of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct the works of our hands upon us.
verses.90:1: A praise of a song, for David. The one who dwells in the help of the Most High will lodge in the shelter of the God of heaven.
verses.90:2: He will say to God, "You are my protector, and my God is my refuge; I will hope in Him."
verses.90:3: For He Himself will rescue from the snare of hunters, and from a troublesome word.
verses.90:4: With His shoulders He will overshadow you, and under His wings you will hope; with a shield His truth will surround you.
verses.90:5: You will not be afraid of nightly terror, of an arrow flying by day,
verses.90:6: of a thing passing through in darkness, of calamity and a midday demon.
verses.90:7: A thousand will fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, yet it will not draw near to you.
verses.90:8: Only with your eyes will you observe, and you will see the repayment of sinners.
verses.90:9: For You, Lord, are my hope; you have made the Most High your refuge.
verses.90:10: Evils will not come to you, and a scourge will not draw near to your dwelling.
verses.90:11: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in your ways.
verses.90:12: On their hands they will lift you up, so that you never strike your foot against a stone.
verses.90:13: Upon an asp and a basilisk you will tread, and you will trample down a lion and a dragon.
verses.90:14: "Because he has hoped in Me, I will rescue him; I will shelter him, because he has known My name.
verses.90:15: He will call upon Me, and I will hear him; I am with him in affliction, and I will deliver and glorify him.
verses.90:16: With length of days I will satisfy him, and I will show him My salvation."
verses.91:1: A psalm of a song, for the day of the Sabbath.
verses.91:2: It is good to give thanks to the Lord and to sing psalms to Your name, Most High,
verses.91:3: to declare Your mercy in the morning and Your truth by night,
verses.91:4: on a ten-stringed harp, with a song on a lyre.
verses.91:5: For You have made me glad, Lord, in Your work, and in the works of Your hands I will exult.
verses.91:6: How Your works have been magnified, Lord; Your thoughts have become exceedingly weighty.
verses.91:7: A foolish man will not know, and one without understanding will not understand these things.
verses.91:8: When the sinners sprout up like grass and all those who work lawlessness have peered forth, it is so that they may be utterly destroyed forever and ever.
verses.91:9: But You are Most High forever, Lord.
verses.91:10: For look, Your enemies will perish, and all those who work lawlessness will be scattered.
verses.91:11: And my horn will be exalted like that of a unicorn, and my old age will be in rich oil.
verses.91:12: And my eye has looked upon my enemies, and my ear will hear concerning the evildoers who rise up against me.
verses.91:13: A righteous one will blossom like a palm tree; like the cedar in Lebanon he will be multiplied.
verses.91:14: Planted in the house of the Lord, in the courts of our God they will blossom forth.
verses.91:15: Then they will be multiplied in a rich old age, and they will be thriving,
verses.91:16: to declare that the Lord my God is upright, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
verses.92:1: For the day before the Sabbath, when the earth was inhabited; a praise of a song for David. The Lord reigned; He clothed Himself with splendor. The Lord clothed Himself with power and girded Himself, for indeed He made the inhabited world firm, which will not be shaken.
verses.92:2: Your throne is prepared from then; from eternity You are.
verses.92:3: The rivers lifted up, Lord; the rivers lifted up their voices.
verses.92:4: From the voices of many waters, wondrous are the surges of the sea; wondrous in the heights is the Lord.
verses.92:5: Your testimonies have been proven exceedingly trustworthy; holiness is fitting for Your house, Lord, for length of days.
verses.93:1: A psalm for David, on the fourth day of the week. The God of vengeance is the Lord; the God of vengeance acted boldly.
verses.93:2: Be exalted, You who judge the earth; repay retribution to the proud.
verses.93:3: How long will sinners, Lord, how long will sinners boast?
verses.93:4: Will they utter and speak unrighteousness? Will all those who work lawlessness speak?
verses.93:5: They humiliated Your people, Lord, and afflicted Your inheritance.
verses.93:6: They killed a widow and an orphan, and they murdered a resident foreigner.
verses.93:7: And they said, "The Lord will not see, nor will the God of Jacob understand."
verses.93:8: Understand now, you senseless ones among the people; and you fools, come to your senses at last.
verses.93:9: He who planted the ear, does He not hear? Or He who formed eyes, does He not observe?
verses.93:10: He who disciplines nations, will He not reprove, He who teaches man knowledge?
verses.93:11: The Lord knows the reasonings of men, that they are futile.
verses.93:12: Blessed is the man whom You discipline, Lord, and whom You teach from Your law,
verses.93:13: to give him relief from evil days, until a pit is dug for the sinner.
verses.93:14: For the Lord will not reject His people, and He will not abandon His inheritance,
verses.93:15: until righteousness returns to judgment, and all the upright in heart hold fast to it. Interlude.
verses.93:16: Who will rise up for me against those who do evil, or who will stand beside me against those who work lawlessness?
verses.93:17: If the Lord had not helped me, my soul would almost have dwelt in Hades.
verses.93:18: If I said, "My foot has been shaken," Your mercy, Lord, helps me.
verses.93:19: Lord, according to the multitude of my pains in my heart, Your consolations loved my soul.
verses.93:20: Will a throne of lawlessness be joined with You, one that forms trouble by decree?
verses.93:21: They will hunt for the soul of a righteous man, and they will condemn innocent blood.
verses.93:22: And the Lord became a refuge for me, and my God a helper of my hope.
verses.93:23: And He will repay to them their lawlessness and their wickedness; the Lord our God will destroy them.
verses.94:1: A praise of a song for David. Come, let us exult to the Lord; let us shout joyfully to God our Savior.
verses.94:2: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and with psalms let us shout joyfully to Him.
verses.94:3: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King over all the gods.
verses.94:4: For the Lord will not reject His people, for in His hand are the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are His.
verses.94:5: For the sea is His, and He Himself made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
verses.94:6: Come, let us worship and fall down before Him, and let us weep before the Lord who made us.
verses.94:7: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture and the sheep of His hand.
verses.94:8: Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as in the provocation, as on the day of testing in the wilderness,
verses.94:9: where your fathers tested, examined, and saw My works.
verses.94:10: For forty years I loathed that generation, and said, "They always go astray in their heart, and they themselves did not know My ways."
verses.94:11: So I swore in My wrath, "They will certainly not enter into My rest."
verses.95:1: When the house is being built after the captivity; a song for David. Sing a new song to the Lord; sing to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.95:2: Sing to the Lord, bless His name; proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.95:3: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all the peoples.
verses.95:4: For the Lord is great and greatly praiseworthy; He is to be feared above all the gods.
verses.95:5: For all the gods of the nations are demons, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.95:6: Thanksgiving and beauty are before Him; holiness and magnificence are in His sanctuary.
verses.95:7: Bring to the Lord, families of the nations, bring to the Lord glory and honor.
verses.95:8: Bring to the Lord glory for His name; take up sacrifices and enter into His courts.
verses.95:9: Worship the Lord in His holy court; let all the earth be shaken before His face.
verses.95:10: Say among the nations, "The Lord has become king; for indeed He firmly established the inhabited world, which will not be shaken; He will judge peoples in uprightness."
verses.95:11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth exult; let the sea and its fullness be shaken.
verses.95:12: The fields will rejoice, and all things in them; then all the trees of the forest will exult
verses.95:13: before the face of the Lord, for He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth; He will judge the inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in His truth.
verses.96:1: For David, when his land is being established. The Lord has become king; the earth will exult; let many islands be glad.
verses.96:2: Cloud and thick darkness are around Him; righteousness and judgment are the firm foundation of His throne.
verses.96:3: Fire will go before Him and will set His enemies ablaze all around.
verses.96:4: His lightning flashes shone upon the inhabited world; the earth saw and was shaken.
verses.96:5: The mountains melted like wax before the face of the Lord, before the face of the Lord of all the earth.
verses.96:6: The heavens declared His righteousness, and all the peoples saw His glory.
verses.96:7: Let all who worship carved images be put to shame, those who boast in their idols; worship Him, all His angels.
verses.96:8: Zion heard and was glad, and the daughters of Judea exulted because of Your judgments, Lord.
verses.96:9: For You are the Lord, the Most High over all the earth; You have been greatly exalted far above all the gods.
verses.96:10: You who love the Lord, hate evil; the Lord guards the souls of His devout ones; He will rescue them from the hand of sinners.
verses.96:11: Light has dawned for the righteous one, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.96:12: Be glad in the Lord, you righteous ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.97:1: A psalm for David. Sing a new song to the Lord, for the Lord has done wondrous things; His right hand and His holy arm have brought Him salvation.
verses.97:2: The Lord has made His salvation known before the nations; He has revealed His righteousness.
verses.97:3: He has remembered His mercy to Jacob and His truth to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.97:4: Shout joyfully to God, all the earth; sing, and exult, and make melody.
verses.97:5: Make melody to the Lord with a lyre, with a lyre and the sound of a psalm,
verses.97:6: with hammered trumpets and the sound of a horn trumpet; shout joyfully before the King, to the Lord.
verses.97:7: Let the sea and its fullness be shaken, the inhabited world and those who dwell in it.
verses.97:8: Rivers will clap their hands together; the mountains will exult,
verses.97:9: for He has come to judge the earth; He will judge the inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in uprightness.
verses.98:1: A psalm for David. The Lord has become king; let peoples be angry. He who sits upon the cherubim—let the earth be shaken.
verses.98:2: The Lord is great in Zion, and He is high above all the peoples.
verses.98:3: Let all give thanks to Your great name, for it is fearsome and holy.
verses.98:4: And the honor of a king loves justice; You have prepared uprightness; You have done justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.98:5: Exalt the Lord our God, and bow down to the footstool of His feet.
verses.98:6: He is holy. Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and Samuel among those who call upon His name; they called upon the Lord, and He listened to them.
verses.98:7: In a pillar of cloud He spoke to them; they kept His testimonies and the ordinances that He gave to them.
verses.98:8: Lord our God, You listened to them; God, You were forgiving to them, and taking vengeance upon all their practices.
verses.98:9: Exalt the Lord our God, and bow down toward His holy mountain, for holy is the Lord our God.
verses.99:1: A psalm for thanksgiving. Shout aloud to the Lord, all the earth;
verses.99:2: serve the Lord with gladness; enter into His presence with exultation.
verses.99:3: Know that the Lord, He is God; He made us, and not we; we are His people and the sheep of His pasture.
verses.99:4: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with hymns; give thanks to Him, praise His name,
verses.99:5: for the Lord is good; His mercy is forever, and His truth is to generation and generation.
verses.100:1: A psalm for David. Mercy and justice I will sing to You, Lord;
verses.100:2: I will sing praise and understand in a blameless song. When will You come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart, in the midst of my house.
verses.100:3: I did not set a lawless thing before my eyes; I hated those who commit transgressions; a crooked heart did not cling to me;
verses.100:4: when the evil person turned away from me, I did not know.
verses.100:5: The one secretly slandering his neighbor, him I drove out; one with an arrogant eye and an insatiable heart, with him I did not eat.
verses.100:6: My eyes were upon the faithful of the land, so that they might sit with me; one walking in a blameless way, he ministered to me.
verses.100:7: One practicing arrogance did not dwell in the midst of my house; one speaking unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.
verses.100:8: In the mornings I put to death all the sinners of the land, to utterly destroy from the city of the Lord all those who work injustice.
verses.101:1: A prayer for the poor man, when he becomes despondent and pours out his petition before the Lord.
verses.101:2: Listen, Lord, to my prayer, and let my cry come to You.
verses.101:3: Do not turn Your face away from me; on whatever day I am afflicted, incline Your ear to me; on whatever day I call upon You, listen to me quickly.
verses.101:4: For my days have vanished like smoke, and my bones have been parched like firewood.
verses.101:5: I have been struck like grass and my heart has withered, because I forgot to eat my bread.
verses.101:6: Because of the sound of my groaning, my bone has clung to my flesh.
verses.101:7: I came to resemble a desert pelican; I became like a night-raven in a ruined house.
verses.101:8: I lay awake and became like a solitary sparrow on a rooftop.
verses.101:9: All day long my enemies reproached me, and those who praised me swore against me.
verses.101:10: For I ate ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with weeping,
verses.101:11: because of Your anger and Your fury, for You lifted me up and dashed me down.
verses.101:12: My days have declined like a shadow, and I have withered like grass.
verses.101:13: But You, Lord, remain forever, and Your remembrance to generation and generation.
verses.101:14: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to have compassion on her, for the time has come.
verses.101:15: For Your servants have taken pleasure in her stones, and they will have compassion on her dust.
verses.101:16: And the nations will fear Your name, Lord, and all the kings Your glory.
verses.101:17: For the Lord will build Zion, and He will appear in His glory.
verses.101:18: He looked upon the prayer of the humble, and He did not despise their petition.
verses.101:19: Let this be written for another generation, and a people being created will praise the Lord.
verses.101:20: For He looked out from His holy height; the Lord looked from heaven upon the earth,
verses.101:21: to hear the groaning of those who are shackled, to release the sons of those put to death,
verses.101:22: to declare in Zion the name of the Lord and His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.101:23: when peoples are gathered together, and kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.101:24: He answered Him in the way of his strength, "Declare to me the fewness of my days.
verses.101:25: Do not take me up at the midpoint of my days; Your years are through generation of generations.
verses.101:26: At the beginning You, Lord, founded the earth, and the heavens are the works of Your hands.
verses.101:27: They will perish, but You endure; and all of them will grow old like a garment, and like a cloak You will roll them up, and they will be changed;
verses.101:28: but You are the same, and Your years will not fail.
verses.101:29: The sons of Your servants will settle, and their seed will be guided straight forever."
verses.102:1: For David. Bless the Lord, my soul, and everything within me, His holy name.
verses.102:2: Bless the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all His praises;
verses.102:3: the One who forgives all your lawless deeds, the One who heals all your diseases,
verses.102:4: the One who redeems your life from corruption, the One who crowns you with mercy and compassion,
verses.102:5: the One who fills your desire with good things; your youth will be renewed like an eagle's.
verses.102:6: The Lord performs acts of mercy, and justice for all who are wronged.
verses.102:7: He made His ways known to Moses; to the sons of Israel, His desires.
verses.102:8: Compassionate and merciful is the Lord, patient and abounding in mercy.
verses.102:9: He will not be angry to the end, nor will He remain wrathful forever.
verses.102:10: He has not done to us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our lawless deeds.
verses.102:11: For according to the height of heaven above the earth, the Lord has strengthened His mercy upon those who fear Him.
verses.102:12: As far as the east is distant from the west, He has removed our lawless deeds far from us.
verses.102:13: And just as a father has compassion on sons, the Lord has had compassion on those who fear Him,
verses.102:14: for He Himself knows our form. Remember that we are dust.
verses.102:15: As for a human being, his days are like grass; like a flower of the field, so he will blossom.
verses.102:16: For a wind has passed through him, and he will not exist, and he will no longer recognize his place.
verses.102:17: But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity and to eternity upon those who fear Him, and His righteousness upon sons of sons,
verses.102:18: for those who keep His covenant and remember His commandments to do them.
verses.102:19: The Lord has prepared His throne in heaven, and His kingdom holds dominion over all.
verses.102:20: Bless the Lord, all His angels, mighty in strength, who carry out His word, to hear the voice of His words.
verses.102:21: Bless the Lord, all His powers, His ministers who carry out His desires.
verses.102:22: Bless the Lord, all His works, in every place of His dominion; bless the Lord, my soul.
verses.103:1: For David. Bless the Lord, my soul. Lord, Lord, my God, how exceedingly You have been magnified! You clothed Yourself with thanksgiving and splendor,
verses.103:2: wrapping Yourself in light like a garment, stretching out heaven like a skin;
verses.103:3: the One who roofs His upper chambers with waters, the One who makes clouds His ascent, the One who walks on wings of winds;
verses.103:4: the One who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers flaming fire.
verses.103:5: He founded the earth upon its stability; it will not tilt forever and ever.
verses.103:6: The deep, like a garment, is His covering; waters will stand upon the mountains.
verses.103:7: At Your rebuke they will flee; at the sound of Your thunder they will be terrified.
verses.103:8: Mountains ascend, and plains descend to the place that You founded for them.
verses.103:9: You set a boundary that they will not pass over, nor will they turn back to cover the earth.
verses.103:10: The One who sends springs in ravines: between the mountains waters will pass through;
verses.103:11: they will give drink to all the wild beasts of the field; wild donkeys will wait in their thirst.
verses.103:12: Beside them the birds of heaven will dwell; from the midst of the rocks they will give voice.
verses.103:13: Watering mountains from His upper chambers; from the fruit of Your works the earth will be satisfied.
verses.103:14: Making grass sprout for the livestock and green plants for the service of mankind, to bring forth bread from the earth;
verses.103:15: and wine gladdens the heart of man, to brighten a face with oil, and bread strengthens the heart of man.
verses.103:16: The trees of the plain will be satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted.
verses.103:17: There sparrows will nest; the house of the heron leads it.
verses.103:18: The high mountains are for the deer; a rock is a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.103:19: He made the moon for seasons; the sun knows its setting.
verses.103:20: You set darkness, and it becomes night; in it all the wild beasts of the forest will pass through,
verses.103:21: young lions roaring to seize and to seek food for themselves from God.
verses.103:22: The sun rises, and they will be gathered together, and in their dens they will lie down.
verses.103:23: Man will go out to his work, and to his labor until evening.
verses.103:24: How Your works have been magnified, Lord! You made all things in wisdom; the earth has been filled with Your creation.
verses.103:25: This is the sea, great and spacious; there are creeping things of which there is no number, living creatures, small with great,
verses.103:26: this dragon that You formed to play with.
verses.103:27: All things look expectantly to You, to give them their food in due season;
verses.103:28: when You give to them, they will gather; and when You open Your hand, all things together will be filled with goodness.
verses.103:29: But when You turn away Your face, they will be troubled; You will take away their spirit, and they will expire, and to their dust they will return.
verses.103:30: You will send forth Your Spirit, and they will be created, and You will renew the face of the earth.
verses.103:31: Let the glory of the Lord be forever; the Lord will be glad in His works;
verses.103:32: the One who looks upon the earth and makes it tremble, the One who touches the mountains and they smoke.
verses.103:33: I will sing to the Lord during my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I exist.
verses.103:34: May my reflection be sweet to Him, and I will be glad in the Lord.
verses.103:35: May sinners vanish from the earth, and lawless ones, so that they do not exist. Bless the Lord, my soul.
verses.104:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord and call on His name; declare His works among the nations.
verses.104:2: Sing to Him and make music to Him; recount all His marvels.
verses.104:3: Boast in His holy name; let the heart of those seeking the Lord be glad.
verses.104:4: Seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek His face continually.
verses.104:5: Remember His marvels that He did, His wonders and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.104:6: seed of Abraham, His servants, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.104:7: He Himself is the Lord our God; in all the earth are His judgments.
verses.104:8: He remembered His covenant forever, the word that He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.104:9: which He covenanted with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac,
verses.104:10: and He established it for Jacob as a decree, and for Israel an eternal covenant,
verses.104:11: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the measured portion of your inheritance,"
verses.104:12: when they were small in number, very few, and sojourners in it.
verses.104:13: And they passed from nation to nation, from a kingdom to another people.
verses.104:14: He did not allow anyone to wrong them, and He rebuked kings on their behalf:
verses.104:15: "Do not touch My anointed ones, and do not do evil to My prophets."
verses.104:16: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke every support of bread.
verses.104:17: He sent a man ahead of them; Joseph was sold as a slave.
verses.104:18: They afflicted his feet with fetters; his soul passed through iron.
verses.104:19: Until his word came, the oracle of the Lord refined him.
verses.104:20: A king sent and released him, a ruler of peoples, and let him go;
verses.104:21: he appointed him lord of his house and ruler of all his property,
verses.104:22: to instruct his rulers as himself, and to make his elders wise.
verses.104:23: And Israel entered Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.104:24: And He increased His people greatly, and strengthened them more than their enemies.
verses.104:25: And He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal deceitfully with His servants.
verses.104:26: He sent Moses His servant, Aaron whom He chose.
verses.104:27: He placed for them the words of His signs and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.104:28: He sent darkness and it grew dark, and they rebelled against His words.
verses.104:29: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
verses.104:30: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the chambers of their kingdoms.
verses.104:31: He spoke, and dog-flies came, and gnats in all their territories.
verses.104:32: He made their rains hail, blazing fire in their land.
verses.104:33: And He struck their vines and their fig trees, and broke every tree of their territory.
verses.104:34: He spoke, and locusts came, and young locusts, of which there was no number,
verses.104:35: and they devoured all the vegetation in their land, and devoured the fruit of their land.
verses.104:36: And He struck every firstborn from their land, the firstfruits of all their labor.
verses.104:37: And He brought them out with silver and gold, and there was no one weak among their tribes.
verses.104:38: Egypt was glad at their departure, for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.104:39: He spread out a cloud as a covering for them, and fire to illuminate the night for them.
verses.104:40: They asked, and quail came, and He filled them with bread of heaven.
verses.104:41: He split open a rock, and waters flowed; rivers ran in waterless places.
verses.104:42: For He remembered His holy word to Abraham His servant.
verses.104:43: And He brought out His people with exultation, and His chosen ones with gladness.
verses.104:44: And He gave them the lands of nations, and they inherited the labors of peoples,
verses.104:45: so that they might keep His statutes, and seek out His law.
verses.105:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, because He is good, because His mercy is forever.
verses.105:2: Who will speak of the mighty deeds of the Lord, make all His praises heard?
verses.105:3: Blessed are those who keep justice and do righteousness at all times.
verses.105:4: Remember us, Lord, in the favor toward Your people; visit us with Your salvation,
verses.105:5: to look upon the goodness of Your chosen ones, to rejoice in the joy of Your nation, to be praised with Your inheritance.
verses.105:6: We have sinned with our fathers; we have acted lawlessly, we have done wrong.
verses.105:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders, and they did not remember the abundance of Your mercy, and they rebelled as they went up at the Red Sea.
verses.105:8: And He saved them for the sake of His name, to make known His mighty power.
verses.105:9: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; and He led them in the deep as in a wilderness.
verses.105:10: And He saved them from the hands of those who hated them, and He redeemed them from the hand of an enemy.
verses.105:11: And water covered those who oppressed them; not one of them was left.
verses.105:12: And they believed in His words, and they praised His praise.
verses.105:13: They hurried, they forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel.
verses.105:14: And they craved a craving in the wilderness, and they tested God in a waterless place.
verses.105:15: And He gave them their request, and He sent fullness into their soul.
verses.105:16: And they provoked Moses to anger in the camp, and Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.
verses.105:17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered over the assembly of Abiram.
verses.105:18: And fire was kindled in their assembly, and a flame burned up sinners.
verses.105:19: And they made a calf at Horeb, and they worshiped the carved image.
verses.105:20: And they exchanged their glory for a likeness of a calf eating grass.
verses.105:21: They forgot God who saves them, who did great things in Egypt,
verses.105:22: wondrous things in the land of Ham and fearsome things by the Red Sea.
verses.105:23: And He said He would destroy them, if Moses, His chosen one, had not stood in the breach before Him, that He might turn away from the fury of His anger, so as not to destroy them.
verses.105:24: And they despised a desirable land, and they did not believe His word.
verses.105:25: And they grumbled in their tents; they did not listen to the voice of the Lord.
verses.105:26: And He lifted up His hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness,
verses.105:27: and to cast down their seed among the nations and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.105:28: And they were initiated to Baal-peor, and they ate sacrifices of the dead.
verses.105:29: And they provoked Him with their practices, and destruction was multiplied upon them.
verses.105:30: And Phinehas stood up and made atonement, and the plague ceased.
verses.105:31: And it was counted to him as righteousness, to generation and generation, forever.
verses.105:32: And they provoked anger at the water of Contention, and Moses was harmed on account of them,
verses.105:33: because they embittered his spirit, and he spoke distinctly with his lips.
verses.105:34: They did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke,
verses.105:35: and they mingled among the nations and learned their works.
verses.105:36: And they served their carved images, and it became a snare to them.
verses.105:37: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons,
verses.105:38: and they shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters; they sacrificed to the carved images of Canaan, and the land was polluted with murder by the blood,
verses.105:39: and it was defiled by their works; and they prostituted themselves in their practices.
verses.105:40: And the Lord was angered with fury against His people, and He abhorred His inheritance.
verses.105:41: And He gave them over into the hands of nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.105:42: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hands.
verses.105:43: Many times He rescued them, but they rebelled in their counsel, and they were humbled in their lawless deeds.
verses.105:44: And He looked when they were oppressed, when He heard their plea.
verses.105:45: And He remembered His covenant, and He relented according to the abundance of His mercy,
verses.105:46: and He gave them over to compassion before all who had captured them.
verses.105:47: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us together from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name, to boast in Your praise.
verses.105:48: Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity; and all the people will say, "So be it."
verses.106:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is forever.
verses.106:2: Let those who have been redeemed by the Lord say so, whom He redeemed from the hand of an enemy.
verses.106:3: From the lands He gathered them, from east and west and north and the sea.
verses.106:4: They wandered in the wilderness, in a waterless place; they did not find a way to a city of habitation.
verses.106:5: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted within them.
verses.106:6: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He rescued them from their distresses;
verses.106:7: and He led them onto a straight way to go to a city of habitation.
verses.106:8: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies and His wonders toward the sons of men,
verses.106:9: for He satisfied an empty soul, and a hungry soul He filled with good things.
verses.106:10: Those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death, shackled in poverty and in iron,
verses.106:11: because they embittered the oracles of God and provoked the counsel of the Most High;
verses.106:12: and their heart was humbled in hardships; they grew weak, and there was no one to help.
verses.106:13: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He saved them from their distresses;
verses.106:14: and He brought them out of darkness and out of the shadow of death, and tore their bonds apart.
verses.106:15: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies and His wonders toward the sons of men,
verses.106:16: for He shattered bronze gates, and broke iron bars in pieces.
verses.106:17: He helped them out of the way of their lawlessness, for because of their lawless deeds they were humbled.
verses.106:18: Their soul loathed all food, and they drew near to the gates of death.
verses.106:19: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He saved them from their distresses;
verses.106:20: He sent His word and healed them, and He rescued them from their destructions.
verses.106:21: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies and His wonders toward the sons of men,
verses.106:22: and let them sacrifice a sacrifice of praise, and declare His works with exultation.
verses.106:23: Those who go down to the sea in ships, doing business in many waters,
verses.106:24: they themselves saw the works of the Lord and His wonders in the deep.
verses.106:25: He spoke, and a storm wind arose, and its waves were lifted high.
verses.106:26: They go up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths; their soul was melting away in calamities;
verses.106:27: they were troubled, they staggered like a drunken man, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
verses.106:28: And they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and He brought them out of their distresses,
verses.106:29: and He stilled its storm, and its waves fell silent.
verses.106:30: And they were glad because they became calm, and He led them with the care of His will.
verses.106:31: Let them give thanks to the Lord for His mercies and His wonders toward the sons of men;
verses.106:32: let them exalt Him in assemblies of the people, and in seats of elders let them praise Him.
verses.106:33: He turned rivers into a wilderness, and outlets of water into thirst,
verses.106:34: a fruitful land into saltiness, because of the wickedness of those dwelling in it.
verses.106:35: He turned a wilderness into harbors of water,
verses.106:36: and He settled the hungry there, and they established a city of dwelling,
verses.106:37: and they sowed fields and planted vineyards, and produced fruit of harvest.
verses.106:38: And He blessed them, and they multiplied greatly, and He did not diminish their livestock.
verses.106:39: And they became few and were harmed because of the affliction of calamities and pain.
verses.106:40: Contempt was poured out upon rulers, and He made them wander in a pathless place and not a way.
verses.106:41: And He helped a poor man out of poverty, and made families like sheep.
verses.106:42: The upright will see and will be glad, and all lawlessness will shut its mouth.
verses.106:43: Who is wise and will keep these things, and they will understand the mercies of the Lord?
verses.107:1: A song of a psalm for David.
verses.107:2: My heart is ready, God, my heart is ready; I will sing and make melody in my glory.
verses.107:3: Awake, harp and lyre; I will awaken at dawn.
verses.107:4: I will give thanks to You among the peoples, Lord, and I will make melody to You among the nations;
verses.107:5: for great above the heavens is Your mercy, and up to the clouds is Your truth.
verses.107:6: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and let Your glory be over all the earth.
verses.107:7: So that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and hear me.
verses.107:8: God spoke in His sanctuary: "I will be exalted and will divide Shechem, and I will measure out the Valley of Tents.
verses.107:9: Mine is Gilead, and Mine is Manasseh, and Ephraim is the protection of My head; Judah is My king;
verses.107:10: Moab is the basin of My hope; over Idumea I will stretch out My sandal; to Me the foreigners were subjected."
verses.107:11: Who will bring me into a fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Idumea?
verses.107:12: Is it not You, God, who rejected us? And will You not go out, God, with our armies?
verses.107:13: Give us help from affliction, and the salvation of man is futile.
verses.107:14: In God we will exercise power, and He Himself will bring our enemies to nothing.
verses.108:1: For the end; a psalm for David. God, do not pass over my praise in silence,
verses.108:2: for the mouth of a sinner and the mouth of a deceitful man were opened against me; they spoke against me with a deceitful tongue,
verses.108:3: and with words of hatred they surrounded me, and they fought against me without cause.
verses.108:4: Instead of loving me, they were slandering me, but I was praying;
verses.108:5: and they set evil against me in return for good, and hatred in return for my love.
verses.108:6: Appoint a sinner over him, and let a slanderer stand at his right hand;
verses.108:7: when he is judged, may he come out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
verses.108:8: Let his days be few, and may another take his oversight;
verses.108:9: let his sons become orphans, and his wife a widow;
verses.108:10: tossed about, let his sons wander from home and beg; let them be driven out from their ruined homes.
verses.108:11: And let a creditor search out all that belongs to him; let strangers plunder all his labors;
verses.108:12: let there be no supporter for him, nor let there be anyone compassionate toward his orphans;
verses.108:13: let his children come to utter destruction; in one generation let his name be blotted out.
verses.108:14: May the sin of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, and may the sin of his mother not be blotted out;
verses.108:15: let them be before the Lord continually, and may their memory be utterly destroyed from the earth,
verses.108:16: because he did not remember to show mercy, and he pursued a needy and poor man, and one pierced in heart, to put him to death.
verses.108:17: And he loved a curse, and it will come to him; and he did not desire a blessing, and it will be far removed from him.
verses.108:18: And he clothed himself with a curse like a garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil in his bones;
verses.108:19: let it be to him like a garment that he wraps around himself, and like a belt that he continually fastens around himself.
verses.108:20: This is the work of those who slander me before the Lord and of those who speak evil things against my soul.
verses.108:21: And You, Lord, Lord, show mercy to me for the sake of Your name, for Your mercy is good.
verses.108:22: Rescue me, for I am poor and needy, and my heart is troubled within me.
verses.108:23: As a shadow, when it declined, was taken away, I was shaken off like locusts.
verses.108:24: My knees grew weak from fasting, and my flesh was altered on account of oil.
verses.108:25: And I became a reproach to them; they saw me; they shook their heads.
verses.108:26: Help me, Lord my God; save me according to Your great mercy,
verses.108:27: and let them know that this is Your hand, and You, Lord, did it.
verses.108:28: They will curse, and You will bless; let those who rise up against me be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
verses.108:29: Let those who slander me clothe themselves with disgrace, and let them wrap shame around themselves like their cloak.
verses.108:30: I will give thanks to the Lord greatly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise Him,
verses.108:31: for He stood at the right hand of a needy man, to save me from those who pursue my soul.
verses.109:1: A psalm for David. The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand until I set Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet."
verses.109:2: The Lord will send forth a rod of power from Zion; and rule in the midst of Your enemies.
verses.109:3: With You is dominion on the day of Your power, in the splendor of the holy ones; from the womb before the morning star I brought You forth.
verses.109:4: The Lord swore and will not relent, "You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.109:5: The Lord at Your right hand shattered kings on the day of His wrath;
verses.109:6: He will judge among the nations; He will fill them with corpses; He will shatter heads over a wide earth.
verses.109:7: He will drink from a stream along the way; because of this He will lift up His head.
verses.110:1: Hallelujah. I will give thanks to You, Lord, with my whole heart, in the council of the upright and the assembly.
verses.110:2: Great are the works of the Lord, sought out for all His desires;
verses.110:3: thanksgiving and majesty are His work, and His righteousness remains forever and ever.
verses.110:4: He made a remembrance of His wonders; the Lord is merciful and compassionate.
verses.110:5: He gave food to those who fear Him; He will remember His covenant forever.
verses.110:6: He declared the strength of His works to His people, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
verses.110:7: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His commandments are faithful,
verses.110:8: established forever and ever, made in truth and uprightness.
verses.110:9: He sent redemption to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; His name is holy and to be feared.
verses.110:10: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord; good understanding belongs to all who practice it; His praise remains forever and ever.
verses.111:1: Hallelujah. Blessed is the man who fears the Lord; in His commandments he delights greatly.
verses.111:2: His seed will be powerful on the earth; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.111:3: Glory and wealth are in his house, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.
verses.111:4: Light has dawned in darkness for the upright; he is merciful and compassionate and righteous.
verses.111:5: Good is the man who is compassionate and lends; he will order his words in judgment.
verses.111:6: For he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be in eternal remembrance.
verses.111:7: He will not be afraid of an evil report; his heart is ready to hope in the Lord.
verses.111:8: His heart is established; he will not be afraid until he looks upon his enemies.
verses.111:9: He has scattered, he has given to the needy; his righteousness remains forever and ever; his horn will be exalted in glory.
verses.111:10: The sinner will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of sinners will perish.
verses.112:1: Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, servants; praise His name.
verses.112:2: May the name of the Lord be blessed from now and forever.
verses.112:3: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the Lord is praised.
verses.112:4: High above all the nations is the Lord; above the heavens is His glory.
verses.112:5: Who is like the Lord our God? The One who dwells on high,
verses.112:6: and looks upon the lowly things in heaven and on earth;
verses.112:7: the One who raises a poor man from the earth and lifts up a needy man from the dung heap,
verses.112:8: to seat him with rulers, with the rulers of His people;
verses.112:9: the One who makes a barren woman dwell in a house, a mother of rejoicing children.
verses.113:1: Hallelujah. When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a foreign-speaking people,
verses.113:2: Judea became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
verses.113:3: The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned backward.
verses.113:4: The mountains leaped like rams, and the hills like lambs of sheep.
verses.113:5: What is it, sea, that you fled? And you, Jordan, that you withdrew backward?
verses.113:6: Mountains, did you leap like rams?
verses.113:7: At the presence of the Lord the earth was shaken, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.113:8: who turned the rock into pools of water, and the flinty rock into springs of water.
verses.113:9: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but rather to Your name give glory, because of Your mercy and Your truth,
verses.113:10: so that the nations may never say, "Where is their God?"
verses.113:11: But our God is in heaven above; in the heavens and on the earth He has done all that He willed.
verses.113:12: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, works of human hands.
verses.113:13: They have a mouth and do not speak; they have eyes and will not see;
verses.113:14: they have ears and will not hear; they have noses and will not smell;
verses.113:15: they have hands and will not feel; they have feet and will not walk; they will not make a sound in their throat.
verses.113:16: May those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.
verses.113:17: The house of Israel has hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their protector.
verses.113:18: The house of Aaron has hoped in the Lord; He is their helper and their protector.
verses.113:19: Those who fear the Lord have hoped in Him; He is their helper and their protector.
verses.113:20: The Lord has remembered us and has blessed us; He has blessed the house of Israel; He has blessed the house of Aaron;
verses.113:21: He has blessed those who fear the Lord, the small with the great.
verses.113:22: May the Lord add to you, to you and to your sons.
verses.113:23: Blessed are you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.113:24: The heaven of heaven belongs to the Lord, but He has given the earth to the sons of men.
verses.113:25: The dead will not praise You, Lord, nor will all who go down into Hades;
verses.113:26: but let us who live bless the Lord from now and forever.
verses.114:1: Hallelujah. I loved, because God will hear the voice of my plea,
verses.114:2: because He inclined His ear to me, and in His days I called out.
verses.114:3: Pangs of death encompassed me, dangers of Hades found me; I found distress and sorrow.
verses.114:4: And I called upon the name of the Lord: "O Lord, rescue my soul."
verses.114:5: Merciful and righteous is the Lord, and the Lord our God shows mercy.
verses.114:6: The Lord guards the infants; I was humbled, and He saved me.
verses.114:7: Return, my soul, to your rest, for the Lord has done good to you;
verses.114:8: for He delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from slipping.
verses.114:9: I will be well-pleasing before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.115:1: Hallelujah. I believed, therefore I spoke; but I was greatly humbled.
verses.115:2: I said in my astonishment, "Every person is a liar."
verses.115:3: What shall I repay to the Lord for what He has repaid to me?
verses.115:4: I will take a cup of salvation, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.115:6: Precious before the Lord is the death of His devout ones.
verses.115:7: O Lord, I am Your servant, I am Your servant and the son of Your female servant; You have broken my bonds.
verses.115:8: To You I will offer a sacrifice of praise;
verses.115:9: I will pay my vows to the Lord before all His people,
verses.115:10: in the courts of the house of the Lord, in your midst, Jerusalem.
verses.116:1: Hallelujah. Praise the Lord, all the nations; let all the peoples praise Him,
verses.116:2: for His mercy has been made strong over us, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.
verses.117:1: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is forever.
verses.117:2: Let the house of Israel now say that He is good, that His mercy is forever.
verses.117:3: Let the house of Aaron now say that He is good, that His mercy is forever.
verses.117:4: Let all who fear the Lord now say that He is good, that His mercy is forever.
verses.117:5: In distress I called upon the Lord, and He answered me into a broad place.
verses.117:6: The Lord is a helper to me; I will not fear. What will man do to me?
verses.117:7: The Lord is a helper to me, and I will look upon my enemies.
verses.117:8: It is better to rely on the Lord than to rely on man.
verses.117:9: It is better to hope in the Lord than to hope in rulers.
verses.117:10: All the nations surrounded me, and by the name of the Lord I repelled them.
verses.117:11: They completely surrounded me, and by the name of the Lord I repelled them.
verses.117:12: They surrounded me like bees around a honeycomb, and they blazed up like fire among thorns, and by the name of the Lord I repelled them.
verses.117:13: Having been pushed, I was toppled so as to fall, and the Lord supported me.
verses.117:14: The Lord is my strength and my song of praise, and He became salvation to me.
verses.117:15: A sound of exultation and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. The right hand of the Lord performed a mighty deed.
verses.117:16: The right hand of the Lord exalted me.
verses.117:17: I will not die, but I will live, and I will recount the works of the Lord.
verses.117:18: The Lord severely disciplined me, yet He did not hand me over to death.
verses.117:19: Open for me the gates of righteousness; entering through them, I will give thanks to the Lord.
verses.117:20: This is the gate of the Lord; righteous ones will enter through it.
verses.117:21: I will give thanks to You, for You answered me and became salvation to me.
verses.117:22: The stone that the builders rejected, this one became the head of the corner.
verses.117:23: From the Lord this came about, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.117:24: This is the day that the Lord made; let us exult and be glad in it.
verses.117:25: O Lord, save now; O Lord, grant success now.
verses.117:26: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord; we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.
verses.117:27: The Lord is God, and He shone upon us; arrange a festival with dense branches up to the horns of the altar.
verses.117:28: You are my God, and I will give thanks to You; You are my God, and I will exalt You. I will give thanks to You, for You answered me and became salvation to me.
verses.117:29: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy is forever.
verses.118:1: Hallelujah. Blessed are the blameless in the way, those who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.118:2: Blessed are those who search out His testimonies; with a whole heart they seek Him out.
verses.118:3: For those who work lawlessness have not walked in His ways.
verses.118:4: You commanded Your commandments to be kept diligently.
verses.118:5: Oh, that my ways might be directed to keep Your statutes!
verses.118:6: Then I will certainly not be ashamed when I look upon all Your commandments.
verses.118:7: I will give thanks to You, Lord, with uprightness of heart, when I have learned the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:8: I will keep Your statutes; do not forsake me utterly.
verses.118:9: By what will a young man set his way right? By keeping Your words.
verses.118:10: With a whole heart I have sought You out; do not thrust me away from Your commandments.
verses.118:11: In my heart I have hidden Your utterances, so that I may not sin against You.
verses.118:12: Blessed are You, Lord; teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:13: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Your mouth.
verses.118:14: In the way of Your testimonies I delighted, as over all wealth.
verses.118:15: On Your commandments I will reflect, and I will seek out Your ways.
verses.118:16: On Your statutes I will meditate; I will not forget Your words.
verses.118:17: Recompense Your servant; I will live, and I will keep Your words.
verses.118:18: Uncover my eyes, and I will perceive Your wonders from Your law.
verses.118:19: I am a sojourner on the earth; do not turn Your commandments away from me.
verses.118:20: My soul has longed to desire Your statutes at all times.
verses.118:21: You have rebuked the arrogant; cursed are those who turn aside from Your commandments.
verses.118:22: Take away reproach and contempt from me, because I have sought out Your testimonies.
verses.118:23: For indeed rulers sat and were speaking against me, but Your servant was reflecting on Your statutes.
verses.118:24: For indeed Your testimonies are my meditation, and my counsels are Your statutes.
verses.118:25: My soul has clung to the ground; I will live according to Your utterance.
verses.118:26: I have declared Your ways, and You heard me; teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:27: And make me understand the way of Your statutes, and I will reflect on Your wonders.
verses.118:28: My soul has grown drowsy from despondency; confirm me in Your words.
verses.118:29: Remove the way of unrighteousness from me, and by Your law have mercy on me.
verses.118:30: I have chosen the way of truth; I have not forgotten Your judgments.
verses.118:31: I have clung to Your testimonies; Lord, do not put me to shame.
verses.118:32: I ran the way of Your commandments when You enlarged my heart.
verses.118:33: Lay down as law for me, Lord, the way of Your statutes, and I will seek it out continually.
verses.118:34: Give me understanding, and I will seek out Your law, and I will keep it with my whole heart.
verses.118:35: Guide me in the path of Your commandments, because I have desired it.
verses.118:36: Incline my heart to Your testimonies and not to greed.
verses.118:37: Turn my eyes away from seeing futility; in Your way give me life.
verses.118:38: Establish for Your servant regarding Your utterance, for the fear of You.
verses.118:39: Take away my reproach which I have dreaded, for Your judgments are good.
verses.118:40: Look, I have desired Your commandments; in Your righteousness give me life.
verses.118:41: And may Your mercy come upon me, Lord, Your salvation according to Your mercy.
verses.118:42: And I will answer those who reproach me with a word, because I have hoped in Your words.
verses.118:43: And do not utterly take away a word of truth from my mouth, because I have set my hope on Your judgments.
verses.118:44: And I will keep Your law continually, forever, and forever and ever.
verses.118:45: And I was walking in a wide place, because I have sought out Your commandments.
verses.118:46: And I was speaking of Your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.
verses.118:47: And I was meditating on Your commandments, which You loved greatly.
verses.118:48: And I lifted up my hands toward Your commandments, which You loved greatly, and I was reflecting on Your statutes.
verses.118:49: Remember Your word concerning Your servants, in which You have caused me to hope.
verses.118:50: This comforted me in my humiliation, because I have not turned aside from Your utterance.
verses.118:51: The arrogant were acting lawlessly to the utmost, yet I did not turn aside from Your law.
verses.118:52: I remembered Your judgments from of old, Lord, and I was comforted.
verses.118:53: Dejection took hold of me because of sinners who forsake Your law.
verses.118:54: Your statutes were songs to me in the place of my sojourning.
verses.118:55: I remembered Your name in the night, Lord, and I kept Your law.
verses.118:56: This has become mine: I have sought out Your statutes.
verses.118:57: You are my portion, Lord; I said that I would keep Your commandments.
verses.118:58: I implored Your face with my whole heart; have mercy on me according to Your utterance.
verses.118:59: For I reasoned according to Your ways, and I turned my feet back to Your testimonies.
verses.118:60: I was prepared and was not troubled to keep Your commandments.
verses.118:61: Cords of sinners wrapped around me, and I did not forget Your law.
verses.118:62: At midnight I would rise up to give thanks to You for the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:63: I am a companion of all those who fear You and keep Your commandments.
verses.118:64: All the earth is full of Your mercy, Lord; teach me Your statutes, Lord.
verses.118:65: You have shown goodness to Your servant, Lord, according to Your utterance.
verses.118:66: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge, because I have believed Your commandments.
verses.118:67: Before I was humbled, I erred; therefore I have kept Your utterance.
verses.118:68: You are good, Lord, and in Your goodness teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:69: The unrighteousness of the arrogant has been multiplied against me, but with my whole heart I will search out Your commandments.
verses.118:70: Their heart has curdled like milk, but I have meditated on Your law.
verses.118:71: It is good for me that You humbled me, so that I might learn Your statutes.
verses.118:72: The law of Your mouth is better for me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.118:73: Your hands formed me and prepared me; give me understanding, and I will learn Your commandments.
verses.118:74: Those who fear You will see me and rejoice, because I have set my hope on Your words.
verses.118:75: I know, Lord, that in righteousness and truth Your judgments have humbled me.
verses.118:76: Now let Your mercy come to comfort me, and Your utterance to Your servant.
verses.118:77: Let Your compassions come to me, and I will live, because Your law is my meditation.
verses.118:78: Let the arrogant be put to shame, because they unjustly acted lawlessly against me; but I will reflect on Your commandments.
verses.118:79: Let those who fear You and those who know Your testimonies return.
verses.118:80: Let my heart become blameless in Your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.
verses.118:81: My soul fails for Your salvation, and I have set my hope on Your word.
verses.118:82: My eyes have failed for Your utterance, saying, "They have comforted me."
verses.118:83: For I have become like a wineskin in frost; I have not forgotten Your statutes.
verses.118:84: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment for me against those who persecute me?
verses.118:85: Lawless ones recounted idle tales to me, but not like Your law, Lord.
verses.118:86: All Your commandments are truth; they have persecuted me unjustly; help me.
verses.118:87: They almost put an end to me on the earth, but I did not forsake Your commandments.
verses.118:88: According to Your mercy I will live, and I will keep the testimonies of Your mouth.
verses.118:89: Forever, Lord, Your word remains in heaven.
verses.118:90: To generation and generation is Your truth; You founded the earth, and it remains.
verses.118:91: By Your ordinance the day remains, because all things are Your servants.
verses.118:92: If it were not that Your law is my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
verses.118:93: Forever I will certainly not forget Your statutes, because by them You have given me life, Lord.
verses.118:94: I am Yours, Lord; save me, because I have sought out Your statutes.
verses.118:95: And I have understood Your testimonies.
verses.118:96: I have seen an end to all perfection; Your commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.118:97: How I have loved Your law, Lord! All the day it is my meditation.
verses.118:98: Beyond my enemies You have made me wise by Your commandments, because they are mine forever.
verses.118:99: Beyond all those who teach me I have understood, because Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.118:100: Beyond elders I have understood, because I have sought Your commandments.
verses.118:101: From every evil way I have held back my feet, so that I might keep Your words.
verses.118:102: From Your regions I have not turned aside, because You have laid down law for me.
verses.118:103: How sweet are Your utterances to my throat, more than honey and honeycomb to my mouth!
verses.118:104: From Your commandments I have understood; therefore I have hated every way of unrighteousness, because You have laid down law for me.
verses.118:105: A lamp to my feet is Your law, and a light to my paths.
verses.118:106: I have sworn and confirmed to keep the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:107: I have been humbled to the utmost; Lord, give me life according to Your utterance.
verses.118:108: Bless the freewill offerings of my mouth, Lord, and teach me Your judgments.
verses.118:109: My soul is in the hands continually, and I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:110: Sinners have set a snare for me, and I have not gone astray from Your commandments.
verses.118:111: I have inherited Your testimonies forever, because they are the exultation of my heart.
verses.118:112: I have inclined my heart to do Your statutes forever, continually, as a recompense.
verses.118:113: Lawless ones I have hated, and Your law I have loved.
verses.118:114: You are my helper and my upholder, and I have hoped in Your people.
verses.118:115: Turn aside from me, you who do evil, and I will search out the commandments of my God.
verses.118:116: Uphold me according to Your utterance and give me life, and do not put me to shame from my expectation.
verses.118:117: Help me, and I will be saved, and I will meditate on Your statutes continually.
verses.118:118: You have despised all those who fall away from Your statutes, because their thought is unrighteous.
verses.118:119: I have reckoned all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; therefore I have loved Your testimonies continually.
verses.118:120: Nail down my flesh out of fear of You, for I have been afraid of Your judgments.
verses.118:121: I have done judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those who wrong me.
verses.118:122: Receive Your servant for good things; do not let the arrogant falsely accuse me.
verses.118:123: My eyes have failed for Your salvation and for the utterance of Your righteousness.
verses.118:124: Deal with Your servant according to Your utterance, and teach me according to Your statutes.
verses.118:125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, and I will know Your testimonies.
verses.118:126: It is time for the Lord to act; they have shattered Your law.
verses.118:127: Therefore I have loved Your commandments more than gold and topaz.
verses.118:128: Therefore according to all Your commandments I was set right; every unrighteous way I have hated.
verses.118:129: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore my soul has searched them out.
verses.118:130: The disclosure of Your words will give light, and will give understanding to infants.
verses.118:131: I opened my mouth and drew in breath, because I was longing for Your commandments.
verses.118:132: Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgment of those who love Your name.
verses.118:133: Direct my steps according to Your utterance, and let no lawlessness rule over me.
verses.118:134: Redeem me from the false accusation of people, and I will keep Your commandments.
verses.118:135: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:136: My eyes ran down with streams of waters, since they did not keep Your law.
verses.118:137: Righteous are You, Lord, and upright is Your judgment.
verses.118:138: You have commanded Your testimonies as righteousness and exceeding truth.
verses.118:139: Zeal for Your house has wasted me away, because my enemies have forgotten Your commandments.
verses.118:140: Your utterance is exceedingly refined by fire, and Your servant has loved it.
verses.118:141: I am young and despised; I have not forgotten Your statutes.
verses.118:142: Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and Your word is truth.
verses.118:143: Afflictions and distress have found me; Your commandments are my meditation.
verses.118:144: Your testimonies are righteousness forever; give me understanding, and give me life.
verses.118:145: I have cried out with a whole heart; hear me, Lord; I will seek out Your statutes.
verses.118:146: I have cried out to You; save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.
verses.118:147: They came upon me in the untimely hour, and I cried out; I have set my hope on Your words.
verses.118:148: My eyes anticipated rising early toward You, to meditate on Your utterances.
verses.118:149: Hear my voice, Lord, according to Your utterance; according to Your judgment give me life.
verses.118:150: Those who persecute me with lawlessness have drawn near, but from Your law they have gone far away.
verses.118:151: You are near, Lord, and all Your ways are truth.
verses.118:152: From the beginning I have known from Your testimonies that You have founded them forever.
verses.118:153: See my humiliation and rescue me, because I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.118:154: Judge my cause and redeem me; because of Your word give me life.
verses.118:155: Salvation is far from sinners, because they have not sought out Your statutes.
verses.118:156: Your compassions are exceedingly many, Lord; according to Your judgments give me life.
verses.118:157: Many are those who persecute me and afflict me; from Your testimonies I have not turned aside.
verses.118:158: I saw those who break faith and I was wasting away, because they did not keep Your utterances.
verses.118:159: See that I have loved Your commandments, Lord; in Your mercy give me life.
verses.118:160: The beginning of Your words is truth, and all the judgments of Your righteousness are forever.
verses.118:161: Rulers have persecuted me without cause, and at Your words my heart was afraid.
verses.118:162: I will exult over Your utterances, like one who finds much spoil.
verses.118:163: Unrighteousness I have hated and abhorred, but Your law I have loved.
verses.118:164: Seven times a day I have praised You for the judgments of Your righteousness.
verses.118:165: Great peace belongs to those who love Your law, and there is no stumbling block for them.
verses.118:166: I was waiting for Your salvation, Lord, and I have loved Your commandments.
verses.118:167: And my soul has kept Your testimonies, and has loved them greatly.
verses.118:168: I have kept Your commandments and Your testimonies, because all my ways are before You.
verses.118:169: Now let my supplication draw near before You, Lord, Lord; according to Your utterance give me understanding.
verses.118:170: May my petition come in before You; according to Your utterance deliver me.
verses.118:171: My lips have poured forth a hymn whenever You teach me Your statutes.
verses.118:172: May my tongue speak Your utterance, because all Your commandments are righteousness.
verses.118:173: Let Your hand come to save, because I have chosen Your commandments.
verses.118:174: I have longed for Your salvation, Lord, and Your law is my meditation.
verses.118:175: My soul will live and will praise You, and Your judgments will help me.
verses.118:176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; give life to Your servant, because I have not forgotten Your commandments.
verses.119:1: A song of the steps. To the Lord, in my distress, I cried out, and He listened to me.
verses.119:2: Lord, rescue my soul from unjust lips and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.119:3: What might be given to you, and what might be added to you, against a deceitful tongue?
verses.119:4: The arrows of the mighty one, sharpened, with the coals of the desert.
verses.119:5: Woe to me, because my sojourn has been prolonged; I have camped among the tents of Kedar.
verses.119:6: My soul has long sojourned with those who hate peace.
verses.119:7: I was peaceable; whenever I spoke to them, they made war against me without cause.
verses.120:1: A song of the steps. I lifted up my eyes to the mountains; from where will my help come?
verses.120:2: My help is from the Lord, the One who made heaven and earth.
verses.120:3: Do not give your foot to slipping, and the One who guards you will not grow drowsy.
verses.120:4: Look, the One who guards Israel will neither grow drowsy nor awaken.
verses.120:5: The Lord will guard you; the Lord is your shelter at your right hand.
verses.120:6: By day the sun will not burn you, nor the moon by night.
verses.120:7: The Lord will guard you from all evil; may He guard your soul.
verses.120:8: The Lord will guard your coming in and your going out from now on and forever.
verses.121:1: A song of the steps. For David. I rejoiced over those who said to me, "We will go to the house of the Lord."
verses.121:2: Our feet were standing in the courts of Jerusalem.
verses.121:3: Jerusalem, being built as a city whose fellowship is together.
verses.121:4: For there the tribes of the Lord went up, a testimony of Israel, to give thanks to the name of the Lord,
verses.121:5: because there thrones sat for judgment, thrones over the house of David,
verses.121:6: and prosperity for those who love you. Ask now for the things pertaining to peace for Jerusalem.
verses.121:7: May your peace now be in your strength, and prosperity in your fortified towers,
verses.121:8: for the sake of my brothers and my neighbors. And I was speaking peace concerning you;
verses.121:9: for the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I sought on your behalf.
verses.122:1: A song of the steps. To You I have lifted up my eyes, You who dwell in heaven.
verses.122:2: Look, as the eyes of servants are toward the hands of their masters, as the eyes of a maidservant are toward the hands of her mistress, so our eyes are toward the Lord our God, until He has compassion on us.
verses.122:3: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, for we have been greatly filled with contempt.
verses.122:4: Our soul has been filled even more; reproach to those who prosper, and contempt to the proud.
verses.123:1: A song of the steps. For David. "If the Lord had not been among us," let Israel now say,
verses.123:2: "if the Lord had not been among us when people rose up against us,
verses.123:3: then they would have swallowed us alive when their wrath raged against us.
verses.123:4: Then the water would have drowned us; our soul would have passed through a torrent;
verses.123:5: then our soul would have passed through the overwhelming water."
verses.123:6: Blessed is the Lord, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
verses.123:7: Our soul was rescued like a sparrow from the snare of the hunters; the snare was shattered, and we were rescued.
verses.123:8: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the One who made heaven and earth.
verses.124:1: A song of the steps. Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion; the one who dwells in Jerusalem will never be shaken.
verses.124:2: Mountains are around her, and the Lord is around His people from now on and forever.
verses.124:3: For He will not leave the rod of the sinners upon the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous may not stretch out their hands in lawlessness.
verses.124:4: Do good, Lord, to those who are good and to those who are upright in heart.
verses.124:5: But those who turn aside into twisted ways the Lord will lead away with those who practice lawlessness. Peace upon Israel.
verses.125:1: A song of the steps. When the Lord brought back the captivity of Zion, we became like those who have been comforted.
verses.125:2: Then our mouth was filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation; then they will say among the nations, "The Lord did great things with them."
verses.125:3: The Lord did great things with us; we became glad.
verses.125:4: Bring back, Lord, our captivity, like the winter torrent in the south.
verses.125:5: Those who sow in tears will reap in exultation.
verses.125:6: Going along, they went on and wept, carrying their seeds; but coming, they will arrive in exultation, carrying their sheaves.
verses.126:1: A song of the steps. Unless the Lord builds a house, those who build it have labored in vain; unless the Lord guards a city, the guard has stayed awake in vain.
verses.126:2: It is in vain for you to rise early, to get up after sitting down, you who eat bread of sorrow, when He gives sleep to His beloved ones.
verses.126:3: Look, sons are the inheritance of the Lord, the reward of the fruit of her womb.
verses.126:4: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the sons of those who have been shaken out.
verses.126:5: Blessed is he who will fulfill his desire from them; he will not be put to shame when they speak to their enemies in the gate.
verses.127:1: A song of the steps. Blessed are all those who fear the Lord, those who walk in His ways.
verses.127:2: You will eat the fruits of your labors; you are blessed, and it will be well with you.
verses.127:3: Your wife will be like a flourishing vine on the sides of your house; your sons will be like young olive plants around your table.
verses.127:4: Look, in this way the man who fears the Lord will be blessed.
verses.127:5: May the Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
verses.127:6: and may you see sons of your sons. Peace upon Israel.
verses.128:1: A song of the steps. "Many times they fought against me from my youth," let Israel now say:
verses.128:2: "Many times they fought against me from my youth, and yet they could not prevail against me.
verses.128:3: On my back the sinners were building; they lengthened their lawlessness.
verses.128:4: The righteous Lord cut through the neck of sinners."
verses.128:5: Let all those who hate Zion be put to shame and turned backward.
verses.128:6: Let them become like grass of the rooftops, which withered before being plucked up,
verses.128:7: with which the reaper did not fill his hand, nor the one gathering the sheaves his bosom;
verses.128:8: and those passing by did not say, "The blessing of the Lord be upon us; we will bless you in the name of the Lord."
verses.129:1: A song of the steps. From the depths I cried out to You, Lord.
verses.129:2: Lord, listen to my voice; let Your ears become attentive to the voice of my supplication.
verses.129:3: If You should closely watch lawless deeds, Lord, Lord, who could stand?
verses.129:4: For with You is propitiation. For the sake of Your name,
verses.129:5: I waited, Lord; my soul waited for His law.
verses.129:6: My soul hoped in the Lord from the morning watch until night;
verses.129:7: for with the Lord is mercy, and with Him is plentiful redemption,
verses.129:8: and He Himself will redeem Israel from all his lawless deeds.
verses.130:1: A song of the steps. For David. Lord, my heart was not lifted up, nor were my eyes raised high; nor did I walk in great things nor in wondrous things beyond me,
verses.130:2: but rather I was humble-minded. And I lifted up my soul, like the weaned child upon its mother, until You repay upon my soul.
verses.130:3: Let Israel hope in the Lord from now on and forever.
verses.131:1: A song of the steps. Remember, Lord, David and all his meekness,
verses.131:2: how he swore to the Lord, vowed to the God of Jacob:
verses.131:3: "I will certainly not enter into the tent of my house, nor go up onto the bed of my couch,
verses.131:4: nor give sleep to my eyes, or drowsiness to my eyelids, or rest to my temples,
verses.131:5: until I find a place for the Lord, a tent for the God of Jacob."
verses.131:6: Look, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the thickets of the forest.
verses.131:7: I will enter into His tents; we will worship at the place where His feet stood.
verses.131:8: Arise, Lord, into Your rest, You and the ark of Your holiness.
verses.131:9: Your priests clothed themselves with righteousness, and Your devout ones will exult.
verses.131:10: For the sake of David Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed one.
verses.131:11: The Lord swore truth to David, and He will by no means nullify it: "I will place one from the fruit of your body upon your throne.
verses.131:12: If your sons keep My covenant and these testimonies of Mine that I will teach them, their sons also will sit upon your throne forever."
verses.131:13: For the Lord chose Zion; He selected her as a dwelling for Himself:
verses.131:14: "This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, because I selected her.
verses.131:15: Her widow I will certainly bless; her poor I will satisfy with bread.
verses.131:16: Her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her devout ones will exult with exultation.
verses.131:17: There I will make a horn sprout for David; I have prepared a lamp for your anointed one.
verses.131:18: His enemies I will clothe with shame, but upon him My holiness will flourish."
verses.132:1: A song of the steps. For David. Look now, what is good or what is pleasant, except for brothers to dwell together?
verses.132:2: It is like fragrant oil upon the head, coming down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron, coming down upon the border of his garment;
verses.132:3: like the dew of Hermon coming down upon the mountains of Zion; for there the Lord commanded the blessing and life forever.
verses.133:1: A song of the steps. Look now, bless the Lord, all servants of the Lord, who stand in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.133:2: In the nights, lift up your hands toward the holy place, and bless the Lord.
verses.133:3: The Lord will bless you from Zion, the One who made heaven and earth.
verses.134:1: Hallelujah. Praise the name of the Lord; praise the Lord, servants,
verses.134:2: you who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.134:3: Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; sing praise to His name, for it is lovely.
